_Abortion access is being decided in state legislatures across the country._ If anti-choice Republicans gain control of state governments, they _will_ continue to pass draconian abortion bans. | | Fellow Patriot,
---
_“Never give in. Never, never, never — in nothing great or small, large or petty — never give in, except to convictions of honor and good sense. Never yield to force. Never yield to the apparently overwhelming might of the enemy.”_

Those are the words of Prime Minister Winston Churchill in October 1941.
But they are also the clear guiding principles of one of the most impressive U.S. Senate candidates running for office today. And I am proud to give him my strongest endorsement.

His name is Hung Cao. He and his parents fled Vietnam just before the fall of Saigon. They escaped the tyranny and oppressive control of a government that brazenly arrested anyone with whom they disagreed.

America saved Hung’s life - and he repaid this country with 25 years of service after attending the U.S. Naval Academy.

He fought for our freedom in war zones across the world, from Afghanistan to Iraq and Somalia.

But now, Hung is in a new fight: defeating the radical socialism that’s destroying our country from the inside out.

This fight is personal for him, Fellow Patriot. He escaped tyranny and communism once before. _Now, he’s not going to let America go down the same dark path._

Hung is dedicated to putting America first, to fighting for our liberties, to exposing the tactics of tyranny that threaten our very future. He is one of the rare few who will stand up to any foe. He won’t bend and he won’t break. But he needs warriors like you by his side to fight and win.

I’m proud to support this incredible patriot in the fight of his life, and I hope you’ll stand with me to send Hung Cao to the U.S. Senate.**

Thank you for never giving up the fight to **make gun trafficking a federal crime.** After 14 years, my legislation was finally passed in last year's Bipartisan Safer Communities Act. Already, we're stopping the flow of illegal guns into New York.
Thank you for supporting my work to **invest in communities all across our state.** In just the last few weeks, we’ve announced more than $3 million in federal funding for our fire departments, over $6 million for mental health services and a multimillion-dollar investment in child care, high-speed internet and more across the North Country.

My record is about winning real results for the families I swore to serve — not for corporations or megadonors. And none of that would be possible without your continued, tireless support. Thank you.
**But here's the bad news: Republicans are emboldened after their historic victories in New York in 2022. Now, they're laying the groundwork for an even bigger red wave in 2024 — and they're directly targeting my seat. **
We can’t let the GOP undo all of the progress that we’ve made. name: Andy Cohen
subject: If Josh Hawley had his way, the government would not let me be a father. His vote just proved it.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri
body:
Peter — I’m a born-and-raised
Missourian.

And if Josh Hawley had his way, my kids would not be alive today.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/52222?refcode=em20240613-5760&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=5760%2E614464%2EXT-kFx ]Photo of Andy with his kids.

I know that might sound dramatic, and this is a long email. But if you
give me just a couple minutes of your time to explain, I know you’ll agree
— [ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/52222?refcode=em20240613-5760&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=5760%2E614464%2EXT-kFx ]and I hope you’ll then chip in to help Lucas Kunce defeat Josh Hawley
this November.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/52222?refcode=em20240613-5760&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=5760%2E614464%2EXT-kFx ]CHIP IN NOW

It might be easy to assume I’m talking about Hawley’s continued opposition
to marriage equality. He even voted against it in 2022. While Josh Hawley
does seem to care a lot about what happens in my bedroom, I’m actually not
married — just gay.

While it’s safe to assume Hawley’s opposition to civil rights protections
for gay Americans means he doesn’t want me to be a parent anyway, his
assault on my right to build and raise a family has a lot more to do with
reproductive freedom — something that matters to each and every one of you
reading this.

Like many Americans — women, men, gay, straight — I had to rely on IVF to
build my family. I’m so incredibly thankful for the doctors, donors, and
rockstar surrogates who helped bring my kids into the world. Those women
gave me life. They gave me the chance to have a family. And I will be
forever indebted to them.

My son Ben was born in 2019, and my daughter Lucy was born in 2022 — just
a few months before the Dobbs decision. As any parent with IVF kids can
tell you, it isn’t easy. It’s expensive, takes time, and often fails.
Fertilized embryos will almost inevitably be lost, and the costs
associated with indefinite storage means extra embryos are almost always
either donated to research, donated to family, or discarded. It’s an
immense privilege to be able to build a family with IVF, when it should be
a right.

name: Jenkins, Colby
subject: Protect the border, or don’t fund the government.
body:
We wouldn’t need to worry about slim majorities if we stood strong and showed a little leadership
No images? [Click here](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-e-ehtullk-trihsurjy-jr/) [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ehtullk-trihsurjy-r/) Dear Friends,This is our third installment responding to my opponent's **[justification of her vote for the $1.2 trillion Schumer/Biden omnibus spending bill.](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ehtullk-trihsurjy-y/)** Since she is avoiding [our challenge for a series of debates](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ehtullk-trihsurjy-j/), side-by-side, where we stand before voters to discuss these important issues, we are offering a positive comparison in writing and by video. Today I will be breaking down her excuse that we have a **slim majority** so we should take what we can get, her claim that she had **plenty of time** to review the bill, and her statements that we should **bank these wins and fight again in 2025** : [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ehtullk-trihsurjy-t/) **SLIM MAJORITY****Celeste Claims** : We have a slim Republican majority in the House, we need to take what we can get.**Colby Claims** : As Senator Mike Lee said, securing Biden's border lawlessness was within reach but that "_some in the GOP were too eager to help Dems spend_ " ([_see 1 below_](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ehtullk-trihsurjy-i/)). But is that true?**The Truth:** Absolutely yes. Other than a small faction of the far left, almost all Americans are fed up with the utter abdication of control of our southern border to the cartels.
* We're tired of nearly 4 million illegal immigrants coming in every year.
* We're tired of military-aged men from China or countries that sponsor terrorism coming across in the tens of thousands.
* We're tired of hundreds of thousands of our youth being killed by fentanyl overdoses and getting addicted to other hard drugs every year.

We wouldn't need to worry about slim majorities if we stood strong and showed a little leadership:**If the government doesn 't do its job to protect our border, then we don't fund the government.**We have a supermajority of the American public on our side. The people can win, they just need leaders.If Democrats wanted to shut down the government because they refuse to end border lawlessness, let them. Let's see how that goes.Instead, Celeste bailed them out by voting with a MINORITY of Republicans who joined a MAJORITY of Democrats ([_see 2 below_](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ehtullk-trihsurjy-d/)) to pass a $1.2 trillion spending bill with not one policy necessary to secure the border. **1012 PAGES AND 24 HOURS TO REVIEW****Celeste Claims:** Six bills that went through regular order and debate were combined into one Omnibus bill. So they had time to review the six bills before they were combined into one.**Colby Claims:** The bill is 1012 pages, was negotiated behind closed doors, and Celeste had barely 24 hours to review it ([_see 3 below_](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ehtullk-trihsurjy-n/))**The Truth:** Celeste is damned if she does or damned if she doesn't on this one.**Either** she was hoodwinked and voted for a bad bill without knowing what was in it because she voted to suspend Congress' rule that requires 72 hours to review a bill. **Or** she knew exactly how bad this bill was, had reviewed it properly, and yet still voted for it. **WE 'LL FIGHT AGAIN IN 2025 ****Celeste Claims:** We should bank these "wins" and fight again in 2025.**Colby Claims:** We held all the leverage with the American people to codify real wins to secure the border and tie the hands of not just Joe Biden, but any other future liberal president who would try and allow an open invasion of our southern border.Yet, we surrendered without a fight - and gave them late-term abortion and gun confiscation funding while in retreat. _**1 **Senator Mike Lee, "This Bill Could Have Been so Much Better Had Republicans in Either House of Congress Stood United in:(1) Refusing to Fund Biden's Border Lawlessness and(2) Reining in Spending. body:

[noah@bluestonecreatives.com](mailto:noah@bluestonecreatives.com) Patriot,The winds of liberty are blowing! Since December 2023, brother Phil and I have spent nearly half a million dollars supporting LIBERTY-LOVING conservative patriots who want to **Make the Texas House Conservative Again!** All of the candidates we supported are true patriots and courageous leaders fighting for our Texas GOP Platform and Legislative Priorities.These legislators will lead the charge to **ELIMINATE** school property taxes, **STOP** the invasion, **EMPOWER** parents, **END** Democrat committee chairmanships, **BAN** taxpayer-funded lobbying, and **DEMAND** honest/transparent budgets. [](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-ehrjktd-yuddtktydi-y/) I want to congratulate the candidates I endorsed and who won big in the March 5th Primary Election and the May 28th Primary Runoff Election!**Tuesday, May 28th Primary Runoff :**

* Keresa Richardson (HD 61)

* David Lowe (HD 91)

**Tuesday, March 5th Primary :**
* Brent Money (HD 2)

* Wes Virdell (HD 53)
* Mike Olcott (HD 60)
* Shelley Luther (HD 62)
* Mitch Little (HD 65)
* Don McLaughlin (HD 80)
* Caroline Fairly (HD 87)

Learn more at**[HuffinesLibertyPAC.com](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-ehrjktd-yuddtktydi-j/)**. **Phelan Doesn 't Deserve the Speakership** Dade Phelan already relies on the Democrats to vote him for Speaker, so it is not surprising that Phelan and his cronies are so desperate for power that they would recruit Democrat votes to save the Democrat Speaker in his re-election campaign!This was a great election cycle for actual Republicans who hold dear the true principles of Liberty. **My Speech at the 2024 RPT Convention** [](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-ehrjktd-yuddtktydi-t/) "We are going to follow Donald J. Trump to victory in the fall. We are going to make sure the leftists, atheists, and communists are crushed in Texas. Patriots, our greatest days are coming! For liberty, prosperity, and virtue always. God Bless you, and God Bless Texas!" [Listen here!](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-ehrjktd-yuddtktydi-i/) **Trump Is Innocent** The trial and verdict on Trump is a screaming siren of desperation by the deep state and leftists. They obviously will do anything and everything to stop Trump and continue the destruction and looting of the USA. If they can weaponize the courts against Trump, there really is no hope for regular citizens.The kangaroo court action from last week helped Trump. The Trump haters really got nothing out of this verdict, guilty or innocent, they will hate him. But now most Americans recognize what a joke the Democrats have become. Trump's fundraising and support will continue to hockey stick up. This is new gasoline for Trump's campaign. Trump will win all battleground states and sweep in six new Republican senators. A storm is brewing, the winds of liberty are blowing! **New RPT Legislative Priorities** 2024 Republican Party of Texas LEGISLATIVE PRIORITIES:\- Border Enforcement
\- Secure Texas Elections
\- Stop Sexualizing Texas' Kids
\- No Democrat Chairs
\- Ban Taxpayer-Funded Lobbying
\- Secure the Electric Grid
\- Texas is Not for Sale
\- End Federal OverreachThe only thing missing from this fantastic list of "top 8" Legislative Priorities is ELIMINATING THE SCHOOL M&O PROPERTY TAX.As long as Texas has property taxes, you'll never actually own your own property--you'll just be paying rent to the government! **Big Win for Liberty in HD 33** I know we went over the big wins earlier in this email, but I need to give special recognition to Katrina Pierson's win in Texas House District 33. I have known Katrina Pierson since 2012, when we worked together in the trenches to defeat the RINO traitors. She is courageous and tenacious, which is why we worked together on so many fights.Her opponent, Justin Holland, defines what's wrong in the Texas Republican Party. It's a true blessing that he is gone. The huge amount of money that brother Phil and I spent was worth every penny!Sweet sailing, my friend. Liberty is endless. Make this victory count. No mercy. ** Get Informed, Get Involved: Convention for Life** [](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-ehrjktd-yuddtktydi-h/) If you're in the Houston area, consider attending the 2024 Convention for Life!At the Convention for Life, you'll learn the latest tactics of the abortion industry, the way they are targeting pregnant women, and the strategy of the Pro-Life movement to fight back.

Experts in medicine, law, politics, media, and more will share their knowledge with you, teaching you how to debunk the lies.[Click here to get tickets](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-ehrjktd-yuddtktydi-k/). **Texas Right to Life is offering a 30% off discount with the code LIFE30.** May God bless you, your family, and the great state of Texas. Our greatest days are coming. See you on the battlefield for liberty!!For Liberty, Prosperity, and Virtue Always, Don Huffines

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: Did Your Senator Cave to Planned Parenthood?
body:
[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gsjidl-duchtdja-y/) [](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gsjidl-duchtdja-j/) [](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gsjidl-duchtdja-t/) [](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gsjidl-duchtdja-i/)

Dear Pro-Life Friend,

They are back at the trough!

Three years ago the _University of Pittsburgh_ was exposed for conducting gruesome experiments on aborted babies -- with taxpayer dollars.

Pro-life legislators courageously tried to block Pitt's state funding until they stopped experimenting on preborn babies.

But, sadly, many legislators - _including Republicans_ \- caved to radical abortion Governor Josh Shapiro and _Planned Parenthood_ , voting to continue funding their disgraceful acts.

**_Students for Life Action_** __ then launched our education campaigns, and in the 2022 election, voters of Pennsylvania rejected legislators' excuses and ousted a number of incumbents who supported this funding. And this spring, we gave others heartburn too.

But as always, _Planned Parenthood_ and their radical allies in State House are back trying to get more blood money to continue these grotesque experiments.

And now, **Capitol insiders tell us a vote could come at any time now.**

The good news is Pro-life legislators are once again trying to stop state funding to Pitt to hold the university accountable conducting these horrific experiments.

With many incumbents who voted wrong replaced by new, strongly pro-life legislators, you and I have the opportunity to stop these barbaric experiments on the broken bodies of aborted babies.

That's why I'm asking ALL pro-life Pennsylvanians to take 30 seconds to use our simple form to demand legislators stop funding Pittsburgh's gruesome experiments.

**[Click Here to Email Legislators TODAY](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gsjidl-duchtdja-d/).**
The reports of the horrific experiments occurring on the _University of Pittsburgh_ campus are enough to make anyone sick.

**In some of the NIH-funded studies, we found out that they are aborting the babies late-term and keeping some with beating hearts so they can dissect them "fresh."**

These experiments are still being conducted and are potentially illegal.

And this month, PA legislators will vote on the state budget, so now is the time that you and I must rally pro-lifers from across Pennsylvania to make sure legislators know we won't stop until these brutal experiments end.

Will you join us today to demand that legislators take action?

**[Click Here to Email Legislators TODAY](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gsjidl-duchtdja-h/).**
Pro-life leaders have again sounded the alarm on Pitt's barbaric experiments.

And many are ready to take a stand against continuing to fund these heinous acts.

But I'm afraid without pro-life supporters making their voices heard, experiments on aborted preborn babies will continue.

So please act today to tell your legislators to stop funding these atrocious experiments right away.

**[Click Here to Email Legislators TODAY](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gsjidl-duchtdja-k/)**
**[ I also am asking you to chip in $15, $25 or $50 to help us educate and mobilize more pro-life supporters](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gsjidl-duchtdja-u/).**

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, Students for Life Action

P.S. _The _University of Pittsburgh_ receives taxpayer funding, and they are committing horrific experiments on preborn babies_.

**[Take just 5 seconds to email legislators today to end funding these evil experiments -- then forward this message to your family and friends to help mobilize more pro-lifers in Pennsylvania](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gsjidl-duchtdja-o/).**

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: this is a future-altering event!
body:
We’re only a few weeks out from the first...
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

We’re only a few weeks out from the first Republican National Convention (RNC) since _Roe v. Wade’s_ reversal!

As convention delegates craft and finalize the GOP’s new platform, ALL eyes will be on what the Republican position will be on abortion.

**Pro-Life Friend, if you and I want the Republican Party to stand strongly for Life, we have to take action – NOW.**

There is reason to be worried that they might weaken - _possibly severely_ \- the platform on abortion.

That's why I’ve been preparing to lead the fight for Life at the Republican National Convention!

But to make sure the Republican Party’s official platform is unapologetically pro-life, I need a **_MASSIVE_** showing of pro-lifers!

**[That’s why I’m counting on you to please sign your STAND4LIFE! Petition right away](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gvklkk-duchtdja-y/).**

Pro-Life Friend, you and I both know that there are too many weak-kneed Republicans who would love nothing more than for the party platform to completely ignore pro-lifers – _or else try to placate us with an endorsement of some late-term abortion law._

Not only would this allow for over 90% of abortions to continue, but it would be a signal to Democrats that the Republican Party can simply be bullied into moving towards their extreme late-term, abortion-on-demand agenda.

As you know by now, a 15-Week Abortion Limit would permit heinous, barbaric abortions into the second trimester of pregnancy nationwide and sabotage good pro-life legislators.

And frankly, politically-speaking, putting support for a merely 15-Week Abortion Limit in the GOP platform shows weakness.

In order to defeat the Abortion Lobby, the GOP must be all in for _Life._

This means, we need **_STRENGTH_!**

WE are the voters.

WE decide what we want the Republican platform to be through our representatives – _the Republican Party delegates at the Republican National Convention._

And with the grassroots support of good folks like you, I’ll make sure the GOP knows WE are the ones they should be feeling the pressure from – _NOT the Abortion Lobby!_

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: my story in pictures
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Congress
body:
and why I’m running for Congress in Washington.

| | | Fellow Conservative, My name is Tiffany Smiley, and I wanted to tell you a little about myself and why I’m running for Congress in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington, where I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.
---
| | [](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zsgohfresppafbd0bm98livn8bhehvmes71frib0_rp22sh2s8i6ep30spim9oj6cdh2bs)
---
| [](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zqndof5f5bu7pkne0vt0f7hug2c855ne5gbp7h28_rp22sh2s8i6ep30spim9oj6cdh2bs)
---
| | I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse to pursue my passion for helping others in need.
---
[](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z9dgaij1orjelgi80i7ocriejuc4mrttnuok0560_rp22sh2s8i6ep30spim9oj6cdh2bs)
---
I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.
---
| | [](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zpjnctgkolvvghthme10jkbmb1s8jokalir4igig_rp22sh2s8i6ep30spim9oj6cdh2bs)
---
| [](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z6r1s9897cvntvqusq5gag40kfkv1aafsrmghs2o_rp22sh2s8i6ep30spim9oj6cdh2bs)
---
| | In 2005, I received a call that changed our lives forever; Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty’s side.
---
| | [](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z7ccsd6ctbv6gnhp9lo3aoqmrhm9pogerht84630_rp22sh2s8i6ep30spim9oj6cdh2bs)
---
| [](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zoqb3i3a4ph7mqilo6admq24185kvmud1tfmjba8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30spim9oj6cdh2bs)
---
| | When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document on the spot, consenting to Scotty’s immediate discharge from the Army.

**_I refused._**

Since that day, I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.
---
[](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z26p884ee0holjkaogdssq9do2sioaa9aeg6bp08_rp22sh2s8i6ep30spim9oj6cdh2bs)
---
Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.
---
| | [](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z5jvdiftgor2nli76trlau6mrqertgu98q4m5k1g_rp22sh2s8i6ep30spim9oj6cdh2bs)
---
| [](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z3uq939hhtf1qa9n75001u92n9j70dpic6g775cg_rp22sh2s8i6ep30spim9oj6cdh2bs)
---
| | It’s not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way— _and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in Congress.
---
[](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z15namlhcf3l45fo1skm6d6ndm2ue8mj5bsmuo7g_rp22sh2s8i6ep30spim9oj6cdh2bs)
---
In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to ‘see’ our children’s faces, he’s always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.
---

# TECH BREAKTHROUGH:
# New Over-The-Counter Hearing Aid Instantly Fixes Mild & Moderate Hearing Loss -- For Less Than $100!
Over 500 million people stand to benefit from this incredible breakthrough in hearing technology. Could this solve your hearing troubles too?
Have you noticed yourself asking people to "speak up" in normal conversation lately?
Are you turning your television up to higher levels than normal?
Or have you simply felt like the world sounds slightly "muffled"?
If so, you could already be experiencing permanent hearing loss.
It's a frightening realization. But you're not alone -- a recent report revealed that nearly 500 million people now suffer from hearing loss worldwide.
Of course, it's normal for our hearing to fade a bit over time. But what isn't normal is all the extremely loud noise we're now exposed to on a daily basis.
For example, did you know that listening to your headphones at more than 60% volume can cause permanent hearing loss... even if it doesn't sound too loud?
From rock concerts and heavy machinery to airplanes, fireworks, headphones, and more, there are simply more loud noises in our lives that didn't exist a few years ago.
So if you've already noticed your hearing starting to fade, but you're still capable of hearing "well enough"... then you're in what some call "the limbo zone".
You're not deaf yet, but your hearing loss is bad enough that it's impacting your life negatively.
However... it's not so bad that you need traditional hearing aids. They're too expensive, difficult to obtain, and they look terrible.
As a result, you're stuck in limbo. You're getting tired of asking people to speak up. You're sick of people treating you like you're older than you are. You're tired of missing out on the full beauty of sound -- whether it's catching a loving whisper from your partner or truly feeling the groove of your favorite song.
But again, hearing aids -- which cost upwards of $5,000 -- would be overkill.
So, what do you do?
Until recently, you had no good answers. If you or a loved one were in this position of losing your hearing, but you couldn't get insurance... you just suffered quietly.

Dear Friend of Liberty,

I'm writing to inform you about two critical new legal battles we are fighting, and we urgently need your help.

KC Transport, a family-owned trucking company in West Virginia, was unjustly fined for mine safety violations by the Mine Safety and Health Administration (MSHA). **Despite not operating a mine or being adjacent to one, MSHA classified their truck repair facility as a "mine."** This absurd logic allows MSHA to overreach their authority and penalize this family-owned business unfairly. We are challenging this unconstitutional ruling to protect the rights of every small business owner and prevent government overreach from setting a dangerous precedent.

Next, the New Mexico Environmental Improvement Board is attacking the state's small oil and gas producers with unlawful and unscientific regulations. These new rules exceed the Board's legal authority and threaten to bankrupt small family drilling businesses. These regulations are not about protecting the environment; they are about crippling an industry and putting hardworking families out of business. We are representing the Independent Petroleum Association of New Mexico (IPANM) to fight back and ensure fair treatment for these hard-working Americans.

These cases highlight the ongoing threats to our energy independence and economic stability. Your support is crucial in helping us win these battles. By supporting MSLF's new Center for American Prosperity & Energy, you are directly contributing to these vital legal fights. This Center is dedicated to defending the rights of small-scale miners, independent energy producers, and other Americans targeted by overreaching government actions.

name: Senator Rand Paul
subject: This petition will make them go ballistic
body:
It's a win-win scenario

Dear Concerned American,

Your petition to Senate Minority Leader Mitch
McConnell, House Speaker Johnson, your Senators, and your
Congressman is linked below.

It's vital that you submit your petition
immediately.

Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer, Joe
Biden, and the Big Labor bosses are about to go ballistic.

I have introduced the National Right to Work
Act to repeal forever Big Labor's power to force workers to pay
union dues in order to work.

So the union lobbyists, Chuck Schumer, Hakeem
Jeffries, and their allies are going to use every trick in the
book to bury the National Right to Work Bill.

And they want to do it as quietly as
possible.

The union kingpins (and their water-carriers
in Congress) can't afford the consequences of having their
coercive privileges publicly debated and voted on in Congress!

They don't want the American people to know
that:

*** Millions of workers are forced to
surrender part of every paycheck to keep their jobs.

This cash funds violent "organizing" drives,
a limousine lifestyle for union bigwigs, and bankrolls radical,
tax-and-spend politicians like Joe Biden, Chuck Schumer, and
Hakeem Jeffries.
*** Big Labor's power is deadly to millions
of small businesses.

Big Labor politicians and stacked bureaucrats
are strangling small businesses with confiscatory taxes,
destructive laws, and straitjacket regulations.
*** Forced unionism exports millions of good
jobs overseas.

Productivity-killing work rules, workplace
class warfare, slowdowns, "sick-outs," and strikes all take their
crippling toll, closing the doors of many businesses -- for good.
In the fight to force votes on a National
Right to Work law, opponents of forced unionism will face a
showdown against the full might of Big Labor.

That's why it's vital that you act at once to
ignite massive public support for a National Right to Work Bill.

Now is the time to act.

By the time the Right to Work Bill comes up
for a vote, every member of Congress must realize the eyes of the
American people will be watching.

National opinion polls all show that 80% of
the American people agree it's wrong to force workers to pay
union dues under the threat of being fired if they don't pay!

And the National Right to Work Committee, who
has led the fight against forced dues for over 50 years, must
have your help in demonstrating that to Congress.

If the public's attention is fixed on this
battle, Congress will be forced to recognize -- or defy to its
peril -- the massive public opposition to compulsory unionism.

Then we'll see who dares to stand with Big
Labor. . .

. . . and who stands with freedom and the
American people.

It's vital you click to submit your petition
to Mitch McConnell, House Speaker Mike Johnson, your Senators,
and your Congressman immediately to demonstrate to Congress and
the national media the strong support for Right to Work.

It's all part of the National Right to Work
Committee's four-part plan to pass a National Right to Work law:

*** Contact directly by mail up to 10 million
supporters, urging them to demand their Senators and Congressmen
vote for the National Right to Work Bill;
*** Brief personally the hundreds of
favorable columnists, radio talk show hosts, and editorial
writers nationwide who can help mobilize public opinion;
*** Deploy digital advertising through email
and across social media in the days before the vote to really
make Congress feel the heat; and
*** Run TV and radio ads targeting swing
votes in key states and districts.
It is critical in this battle that Congress
hears loud and clear from the nearly 80% of Americans who support
Right to Work.

Of course, Congress may choose to obey Big
Labor bosses rather than the majority of their constituents.
That's their choice.

But time and again, when politicians defied
the public and voted for forced unionism, they've paid the price
with the end of their political careers!

Of course, this whole effort will be very
expensive.

An all-out media and direct-mail blitz to
mobilize massive public pressure on Congress will be the key to
our success.

To pay for the expensive ads, mailings, and
other efforts, it's urgent you send a special contribution to the
National Right to Work Committee today.

Will you make a generous contribution of
$200, $100, $50, $25, or $15 to launch the next, crucial phase
for ultimate passage of a National Right to Work law?

It's vital you act immediately to put the
politicians' feet to the fire to bring the National Right to Work
Act up for a vote.

It would be a crime to let politicians who
support compulsory unionism off the hook.

Up against the forced-dues fed,
billion-dollar might of Big Labor, all the Committee has on its
side is truth, public opinion. . .

. . . and you!

Unlike Big Labor, the National Right to Work
Committee doesn't have (or want) the power to force anyone to pay
dues.

So it has to depend on generous folks like
you.

Please don't make it easy for Chuck Schumer,
Hakeem Jeffries, Joe Biden, and Big Labor to bury the National
Right to Work Bill.

Some folks have already sent $100, $200, and
even more. For others, a contribution of $25 or $50 has been as
much as they could afford.

Please submit your petition so we can
demonstrate to Congress and the media the strong support for
Right to Work.

Without your contribution of $200, $100,
$50, $25, or $15, the National Right to Work Committee won't be
able to contact 10 million Americans, place the advertising,
deploy the whole digital program, or do anything else to put Big
Labor on the spot with a public vote on the National Right to
Work Bill.

And if you and I don't press forward now, we
may never have a chance like this again.

Please help today.

Be sure to submit your petition to Senate
Minority Leader Mitch McConnell, House Speaker Mike Johnson, your
Senators, and Congressman, and then pitch in with your
contribution of $200, $100, $50, $25, or $15 to the National
Right to Work Committee.

Sincerely,

Rand Paul
United States Senator

P.S. Since most Americans oppose Big Labor's
forced-unionism powers, a public debate on my National Right to
Work Bill is Big Labor's (and their water-carriers' in Congress)
worst nightmare!

So please, submit your petition to Congress,
and then pitch in with your contribution of $200, $100, $50, $25,
or $15 to the National Right to Work Committee today.

The National Right to Work Committee is a
nonprofit, nonpartisan, single-purpose citizens' organization
dedicated to combating compulsory unionism through an aggressive
program designed to mobilize public opposition to compulsory
unionism and, at the same time, enlist public support for Right
to Work legislation. The Committee's mailing address is 8001
Braddock Road, Springfield, Virginia 22160. The Committee can be
contacted toll-free at 1-800-325-7892. Its web address is
www.nrtwc.org

Not produced or e-mailed at taxpayer expense.

To help the National Right to Work Committee
grow, please forward this to a friend.

## SCOTUS Rejects Abortion Pill Ban
The Supreme Court [unanimously refused to hear](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFurDAQRb_GdEb2eDC8wsVr6DZtSuSF8TKRwcg2oPx9tKlTXunq6Oh8PqaH58j768Nv5GpIk58rXzRZqVECTtgsLhABmYac7vVg7NCjaVangg9oAiIY-w-NBb8EMGHpls6Tts-GHShAZTWqobOgW1SzVWQpWFC6syBQ0cI15fYr8V5XCvE7XZTbOW1NdGutRxHmv4BRwHjfd1tXuii_6H0QML7xAkYrYNTmvVH3_QC9gLHMqZ5FbhzoyFxq2kn6Z8qV0y4PjlFGf5eTqwyLl-U8Mm0k53Tm2mS3HDfHyMX2AtVr8xx_lerfgS4HPwEAAP__EftnSg) a case that would have banned the use of the abortion pill mifepristone. It was the court's first abortion decision since overturning Roe v. Wade. [The court ruled](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFurDAQQNGvMR3IHg-GLVy8hm5fmxJ5zXh3IoORmQXl76OkTn2LK52P-3wPnHl7_g8reUllDlH4pNm1BlvAGZvFJyIg25A3gxmtGwe0zcuH2wg9LjHR0C_DqGFJjxEtIGJw8ZEa9qABtTOox96B6VBHp8lRcqBN70ChpoWl1O6z8CYvSvmrnFS7WNYm-5fIfij7T8GkYLquq7sk0E9UMIUqHDMpmI73XmmlNpZ3lTY8ShUuW7tyor3yIWWjtuy8cdkUTM7om7P21lS_7BfnzIcbFOrnGjj_juVvhtPDdwAAAP__JP5f5g) that anti-abortion doctors and organizations couldn't challenge the FDA's approval of the drug because the groups don't prescribe or use the pill themselves. Justice Brett Kavanaugh noted that accepting their argument could lead to any professional group suing over policies they disagree with, citing examples like firefighters challenging building codes or teachers disputing immigration policies. However, since the decision was based on a "[legal technicality](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFu7CAQAL_G7rBgweCG4jXu7rUpLYyXuz1hY8HeWfn7KCmjlKNpRvNxW26BMh33_2FHz6ksITK9cbFCGQFmMf3mEyKg7tErpyZtJ2d0__BmVRvaIFOS2oFzGNC4FZK2aOQ2rj15kGCkVUZOowU1GBmtRIvJglSjhc5I3IhLHZ6FDn5gyp_ljXWIZe-zfzCfrdP_Opg7mK_rGo41Hni1b9_BfJZMTLF1MLfXWXFHEcur8m8WFZ8YuYmVNlGxcaXIIsSIrYmwlspUDnFSzqLGI6hRaTn11W_nRTlTs64z8r4Hyj9h_Pemt4evAAAA__-yhGyo)," future legal challenges to the drug, which was used in nearly two-thirds of all abortions in the U.S. last year, could be on the horizon.
## Tesla OKs Musk's $56 Billion Pay Package
Tesla shareholders approved CEO Elon Musk's [$56 billion pay package](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1urDAQhZ8GOiN7bAa2cHEbur1tSjRrhsVZYyPsgPbtI6KUqY50fqSj7-M-3skHH5__aWVb5jSSK_7gEYUyAsxo6snOzMC6Zqs61WvsO6PrxUrSPXXIM6Lr3K3lB82zVhpuaKR0fe0tSDASlZF9i6AaIx1KvhYgVYtQGcmTL2lvPpOPZeE5vNPBe-PSWge7lLLlSv-rYKhgOM-ziQ8X-cxXXsFQ2C2_Ii67goFDimL9yi9x-phF4RxI5IV2XlKYeBdHKixaFA8fgk9RbPQWG7kXPVnsLpJqsb9BvdtpO69Kxq4y8rmSDz-vyt-MDgvfAQAA__-Ja2nv) on Thursday, five months after a judge in Delaware ordered the company to rescind the package. Musk's compensation was one of many proposals approved by shareholders at their annual meeting in Austin, Texas. They [also agreed to](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGSrCAQRb8Gs7agQZwXELzEbDbd0GK0UXZRLBrHmr_fmo03vjc453zex7uPKe7Lh9_I1ZBHP9X4pNGCMoBmNM3sAhGSbsipXt20vfVGN6tD2XkzTeGftqinvg-Wgu60xElpg4Ga6FCikVYZeessqtbIyUqyFCxK1VkURtIcay7tV457XSmkV35Saae8NcmttR4s9H-Bg8Dhuq620Fmp8HsXODxOjjsxCxz8WTNDLX7nI5fqa8y7wGE7-RvYvxgeua5QiZMHXn2hNaeZChTinM73m-HwzHFf4PGCK84Emy9L3BneEiAtKC1waIqbjyumFNn2wshl8zH98ta_6z0d_gQAAP__l_R0Fg) relocate the company's headquarters to Texas from Delaware, re-elected two board members, increased investor control, and lowered voting requirements to a simple majority. Musk responded to the outcome by saying, _" Hot damn, I love you guys. We have the most awesome shareholder base." _Tesla [shares rose 2.9% ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOqzAQAL_GdEbrtTGkcPEaurz2SrQxC_hibAQOKH9_ytVXjzQazdd9uFOIIc3_aWVXpjyQL-HkwUplJJrBVKObmJF1xU61qtO2a42uFtfcuLF6GhvGrvUEDw8IcGPGG7cPzVVwCGjAKgNdY1HVBrwFtjxZBNVYFAZ4DCXv9XcOqSw8xXc-ea99XqvollK2Q-h_AnuB_XVdtU8P_4EC-49aYA9WYK-0wL7wEUkeC-285DjyLjnmJNfX8ZQbveVG_kkzSyqSUnpRlCtzCWmul7LGanfjdoUYw2FbYWBeKcTfjvL3ldPhTwAAAP__7Vhj0A)in regular trading on Thursday to close at $182.47.
## Emergency Declared as Rains Drench Florida
More storms are expected in South Florida today after [intense downpours](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGO6yAQheGnwR0WjAn2LShu4y7bbmmNYYhnRSACNlbefpWttzvS1xz9n9ftipw43z7wTq7HsqHv_KTNSm0kmM0MwUUioGkgp2e9THaZzTQcLpKKGDQReRPCbjSAUrjv06JmPQMN7ECBUVYbtVws6NEobxVZihaUvlgQRlHgXur4VTj3g2J6lSfV0Zf7kNzR-6OJ6b-AVcB6nueYd5_pbG8XsL7nGwj7QVXAGlOpHFDuFT01WZFzxJRkwFeTnDvlRjKUMz_Kd5UxYTtkTKUEzjdZfUZ9sf8mO1QXHienxM3OwqjbHTn9fup_F3o6-AkAAP__rdpqzA) earlier this week produced flash flooding, blocked roads, and flight delays and cancellations across the region. Governor Ron DeSantis issued a [state of emergency](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGOqzAQQNGvMR3IHpsBChevcZfXbokmeBwmcnAETtD-_Spbb3-lI92vy3whybLd_tODfU1lpqXKm2dsjWvBza6JPjED24a9GcxocRycbVaPhsfBpnTtF5gQ7KKpj3yliQxOZKdGPGhwGo3TY49gOqcX1IycELTpEZTTHKWWvbsX2erKKX-XN-_dUh5N9mutz0PZfwqCgnCeZ1dXvr1oj0Lbp1EQXke78XkoCLRXWTIrCB9VQbi_NgXBWAUh5bJLpDZlOtY25VJis_v4PCVnOXBQTt8eJPkXrn9veHv4CQAA__945F5F) late Wednesday for five South Florida counties where rain totals have reached up to 25 inches. Eight million people remain under a flood watch. Miami International and Ft. Lauderdale Airports reported [nearly half of all flights were delayed](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFP8zAUAH-NszWyX5yXdPCQr_oiUSiUAZUtMs5za3DiyLFi8e9RmVnvhpPuchpO2nk3X5_1RCrZMGiT3EYD7oTcgRxkMSpLBFQVpEQj2grbRlbFTdlqj2ZEAmMl35uGUAot6trUo2g_uC6cAg6So5C8rRFEKblBTkgWgYsagUlOo0shlp_BzelG1n-HjWJpwlR4dUtpWVnVMegZ9DnnMoev7S4Z9DPllUGfYlic0X4XtZvXFOJ0p8fL-QHf_h276lCfLs07vB5enrrH7vyfQV9ENS7Zee9WbJjk10k7_5tMfw_YFPwEAAD__zB_W4E), including the flight for the Florida Panthers, who were on their way to a Stanley Cup Final game in Canada on Thursday. Dear Friend of Liberty,

I'm writing to inform you about two critical new legal battles we are fighting, and we urgently need your help.

KC Transport, a family-owned trucking company in West Virginia, was unjustly fined for mine safety violations by the Mine Safety and Health Administration (MSHA). **Despite not operating a mine or being adjacent to one, MSHA classified their truck repair facility as a "mine."** This absurd logic allows MSHA to overreach their authority and penalize this family-owned business unfairly. We are challenging this unconstitutional ruling to protect the rights of every small business owner and prevent government overreach from setting a dangerous precedent.

Next, the New Mexico Environmental Improvement Board is attacking the state's small oil and gas producers with unlawful and unscientific regulations. These new rules exceed the Board's legal authority and threaten to bankrupt small family drilling businesses. These regulations are not about protecting the environment; they are about crippling an industry and putting hardworking families out of business. We are representing the Independent Petroleum Association of New Mexico (IPANM) to fight back and ensure fair treatment for these hard-working Americans.

These cases highlight the ongoing threats to our energy independence and economic stability. Your support is crucial in helping us win these battles. By supporting MSLF's new Center for American Prosperity & Energy, you are directly contributing to these vital legal fights. This Center is dedicated to defending the rights of small-scale miners, independent energy producers, and other Americans targeted by overreaching government actions.

Remember, every donation made by June 14th will be matched dollar-for-dollar by our Board of Directors, doubling your impact.

Please make your secure donation here: [https://mslegal.org/donate/center-for-american-prosperity-and-energy/](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a5d6d19d1e414bee8953f5c23c7e75d2&_e=1Bhrl--kFxDobmVtuLGNhUWN-k2QyfH37AOYGQR2clVHcnJ5BDkzWB_vyb4uoowY8l4iqmt7YIGjBUsijgyLpGcfzxgOJiaPwOQ2YS_z9Kwupdkvh4_J4B2A1iFinKPKg9OZRHznfkuoHx64V6t0em-QRrhREq9W83eMTsNlVZv7oDE3-vOSIiekjsS-4q-k0rvXFSkMe_81MYYatSPi3WAutbMAX9ApNIR1hZHKSfclIzpyk0sPtFjf9_e1qic1VhMrWecJCb0Z37htKiZIxUBKFEdqCDc1ZPCVozZ5G3YHHsXpNsj0JOTBlazWJPgXsjEDP5fg5JZ4kCcpD3FPh2juGBwN2lzElrqT-u5N5UFW2SGUkHM27jTq1E1IPwivO_xGNJQmEo_xw83qY9KzpQ%3D%3D)

**_I refused._**

Since that day, I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

clean_body: and why I'm running for Congress in Washington. | | | Fellow Conservative, My name is Tiffany Smiley, and I wanted to tell you a little about myself and why I'm running for Congress in Washington. I grew up in Pasco, Washington, where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work. | | | | | I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse to pursue my passion for helping others in need. I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career. | | | | | In 2005, I received a call that changed our lives forever; Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both eyes. I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side. | | | | | When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army. I refused. Since that day, I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned. Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. | | | | | It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--and won. We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in Congress. In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys. | | | | | Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for Congress to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and the radical Left. I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to solve their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress. My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed, and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol. **A Message from Senator John Barrasso:**

[](http://links.myfreedomnews.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=de28d7f3f1cc49e09682a76aeb68d584&_e=UDilCogrGXUR9PzDp5-inJkk9YISW8aQxUvOXqcI8sr9HJulwVrFmilDFaP1eQ08WMeEE2FjC_CAT7vjFPSmvjrmUDcupIvcsnsyxeD-pP7GCurR1WL1IE2fKOK8K-jOe0gZQS3k0lrE39IQjm4x0DAnMrGDcpy9AK59-ZyrWR-YGL9uWDL3vlYLTWfRxdtbV4UNw9Rv4Xj5XqSthRcw7h7lmGRpVarBXM97pOtw4orGVCoIKBOPkCLfBrUUMrgxPcJke-GM2yT8LTLKBRKc_g%3D%3D)
I want to take a moment to remind you of my journey to the U.S. Senate, the important le ssons I have learned along the way, and why I continue to believe wholeheartedly in our beloved state.

My father, a World War II veteran, left school during the Great Depression to join the Army. Though he only had a ninth grade education, he built a career as a hard-working cement finisher. My mother, a dedicated voter who never missed an election, instilled in me the importance of civic duty.

From my parents, I inherited an unwavering love for this country that I have proudly carried throughout my life. It's something I strive to keep alive in Wyoming.

Later, in medical school, I learned the importance of having a plan before taking action, a lesson that has proven invaluable in both my medical career and my service as your senator. Just as in surgery, effective leadership requires a clear vision and a strategic approach to problem-solving.

As you may know, I am sometimes referred to as _"Wyoming's doctor,"_ but to be honest, that is what I have always strived to be as your senator. I have wholeheartedly dedicated myself to serving the state, addressing its challenges, and making it the best it can be.

**_Whether it's advocating for our veterans, championing American energy security, or safeguarding our borders, I've always strived to be a voice for all Wyoming people. Your concerns are my concerns, and your aspirations are my aspirations._**

As we look towards the future, I'm confident that Wyoming has the potential to be an even stronger, more prosperous state. **[But it will require strong leadership, a clear vision, and your continued support.](http://links.myfreedomnews.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=de28d7f3f1cc49e09682a76aeb68d584&_e=UDilCogrGXUR9PzDp5-inJkk9YISW8aQxUvOXqcI8sr9HJulwVrFmilDFaP1eQ08WMeEE2FjC_CAT7vjFPSmvjrmUDcupIvcsnsyxeD-pP7GCurR1WL1IE2fKOK8K-jOA0uKCMjpDhU_Mg8jxdKM8AjOxITOnpyFjq4r2sUQ_B-qmrKhiHEajSCe9OtpbcJm_5l0Vl0rJnvcUAhu_fzxseoMdt8N5ZDl3qFGl1ZYv1sP1h2bVSs8HtnWWhoZcXaKuXtJEgvLxIYF6BQbsN562w%3D%3D)**

Already, your support has been instrumental in my journey, and I promise to continue fighting for the issues that matter most to Wyoming families.

Sincerely,
Senator John Barrasso [CHIP IN FOR A STRONG WYOMING](http://links.myfreedomnews.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=de28d7f3f1cc49e09682a76aeb68d584&_e=UDilCogrGXUR9PzDp5-inJkk9YISW8aQxUvOXqcI8sr9HJulwVrFmilDFaP1eQ08WMeEE2FjC_CAT7vjFPSmvjrmUDcupIvcsnsyxeD-pP7GCurR1WL1IE2fKOK8K-jOBn4A8Zc4Uaj8HxXQrScNZM-7vxL7FARNDGlKZjRkvucGRbGipDgYRcUYBbXDXO5U4AUTjElPCfZDBMczI1kT059M7-W-08pDE-zT6u86XYA5lp6zFjkUsnIKERdY5RB1O2ooPG0ditNCJ9RSHFxZsw%3D%3D)

Here's why June is a particularly special month I look forward to every year.
The charm of the new year is long gone. Spring transitions to the exciting anticipation of Summer. Kids are home for break. And we get prepared mentally to take on the second half of the year. All this is obvious to most.
But with a closer glance we recognize June as National Immigrant Heritage Month, Pride Month, and home to Juneteenth. June is also National Men's Health Month, Portuguese Heritage Month, and Caribbean-American Heritage Month. It can seem overwhelming, but I love this month because June reminds us of the intersectionality of our fight for justice and the inherent dignity and equality of all human beings--regardless of differentiating background.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2550223&post_id=145168600&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ1MTY4NjAwLCJpYXQiOjE3MTgzNzA0MzEsImV4cCI6MTcyMDk2MjQzMSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTI1NTAyMjMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.ODW3Y3G_HRTqHsOrtFNjTmgE0ePjDn9Tb-5y_IwUeH8)
Whether it's demanding equal protection under the law for all people regardless of immigration status, standing firmly against all forms of violence, discrimination, and hate directed at the LGBTQ+ Americans, or better educating ourselves on the dire need for racial justice and reparations owed to Black Americans--this month serves as an excellent opportunity to sharpen our activism and our empathy for communities we may not directly belong to.
To me, June is a reminder that human rights isn't a buffet where we get to pick and choose equal rights, and justice isn't pie that decreases when expanded to include more people. They are candles burning brightly to dispel darkness and they work best when we actively work to increase their reach. And we do that successfully by sharing the light, investing in human rights advancement with our time, vote, and resources, embracing the synergy of our efforts for justice, and being relentless in the face of what can often seem like overwhelming injustice.
This June, step out of your comfort zone and engage with the many different communities that comprise our nation and world--and recognize one another. Then, let us work together to uplift all humanity and make this the more perfect Union we were promised.

body:
#
Friend — $5.
That's the contribution I am asking you to make to The Long Run today. Let me quickly explain why:
At the end of June, we face an all-important FEC fundraising deadline for our movement — our first of the election year and one of the last chances we will have to make critical budget decisions on which races we can continue supporting.
Tomorrow marks the midpoint of this month and the honest truth is that we have been pacing behind.
We are legally required to report our fundraising at the end of the month, so we are going to need a lot of help if we want to catch up and file a strong report.
With Primary elections well underway and November quickly approaching, it has never been more crucial that we have the resources we need to help candidates that will take back the House majority and keep the Senate. And the only way we can do that is if we stay on track to hit our goals.
We have a lot of lost ground to make up, so I am counting on you, to contribute $5 to help us get there.

Derek,

One year ago today, House Republicans’ scheme to censure me and fine me
$16 million failed to pass in a bipartisan vote.

The story could have ended there,
Derek, but it didn’t.

Because Donald Trump got personally involved and threatened to support the

personally invested in seeing me punished for my work to hold Trump
accountable.

They brought up another censure resolution against me.

If you recall, just days before this censure vote, Donald Trump was
indicted on federal charges of mishandling classified documents by Special
Counsel Jack Smith.

Trump’s Republican lackeys in Congress wanted to do something to distract
the media attention surrounding their leader — so they came after me
again.

On Fox News, GOP members of Congress attacked me and spread lie after lie
about me. The lead sponsor of the bogus resolution went on convicted
criminal Steve Bannon’s online show to rally far-right support.

And this time it passed, on a purely partisan vote on the House floor.

The attacks have persisted,
Derek. Donald Trump and his
allies continue to come after me at campaign rallies and on cable news.
All because I was willing to hold him accountable by leading his
impeachment, as my oath of office demanded. He will never forgive me for
that.

fight for what is right, true, and just, no matter what obstacles MAGA
Republicans put in our way. As FDR once said, there are times when you can
judge a person by the enemies they have made. By that standard, I’m doing
pretty damn well.

worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values.

After the
Respect for Marriage Act was passed by a bi-partisan effort and
signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only
intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who
wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Are you
concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our
founding-Religious Liberty?

In
addition to the passing of the Respect for Marriage Act, numerous
examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v.
BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL
RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few
examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to
faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to
their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the Respect for Marriage Act,
brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal
Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and
organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex
marriage failed.

This has
the potential to only intensify legal persecution against
individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to
faith-based values.

The
American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to
preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation
for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty,
Community, and Life.

Whether
it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield
after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a
cake that violates his religious values, are you concerned as I
am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who
wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?

Please
share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning
religious liberty in America.

These principles guided us throughout our decades of military service. It's what compelled us to blow the whistle on Donald Trump's attempt to extort our allies in Ukraine when we overheard a concerning phone call. And now, it's what motivated Eugene to run for Congress. Eugene is running for Congress to uphold those same values and continue his fight to defend our democracy and the Constitution we both vowed to protect. And more than that, he will fight to restore and expand the fundamental rights right-wing forces have worked so hard to take away: the right to reproductive freedom, the right to vote, the right for us and our kids to live without fear of gun violence. But he can't win these fights alone. I am with him – nothing is more important to me right now. But we need you with us, standing by our side, because Trump and his allies will do whatever they can to keep him out of Washington. [So, Peter, can I count on you to split a contribution between Blue Amp Action and my brother Eugene Vindman's campaign for Congress in Virginia? ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4b2b2ecf-b1f7-4e43-aa2c-0b48656f5f3a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| The left is predictably losing their minds over our vote this week to hold Attorney General Garland in contempt of Congress for his refusal to turn over the audio recording of the Department of Justice's interview with Joe Biden in the classified documents case. But this is the basic function of checks and balances within our system of government - Congress has an oversight authority over the executive branch. We've asked for the recordings, we've subpoenaed the executive branch, and when they still refuse to hand over the recordings it's our job to hold the Attorney General in contempt.
Now, why do we want these recordings? It's not because of "naked partisanship" as the left has claimed, and it's not to "embarrass Biden" to show how he's old and doddering. We don't need an audio recording to know that Joe Biden is old, doddering, and doesn't have the mental faculties that we expect from a president - we can see that every single day.
The reason we want these recordings is to establish intent, and to answer the basic questions: what was Joe Biden's intent behind his mishandling of classified documents? Did Joe Biden intentionally keep those documents? Did he know that they were clearly not being stored in a secure manner? Did he do all of this with the intent to talk about the classified material with his biographer?
These are the questions we are trying to answer. The audio recording will help us answer these questions. And the fact that Attorney General Garland refuses to turn over these recordings after Congress lawfully requested them warrants that he be held in contempt of Congress, which is why I voted for it.

clean_body: | | | | == | Peter - This week, I demanded answers from the Biden Administration over a clearly political prosecution of a Texas surgeon who exposed transgender surgeries taking place on minors at Texas Children's Hospital. I also voted to hold Attorney General Garland in contempt of Congress over his refusal to turn over audio recordings of the Department of Justice's interview with President Biden. As we get closer and closer to the November elections, I'm going to be doing everything I can to protect and expand our Republican majority in the House of Representatives. We have good, governing members of Congress running in districts Joe Biden won in 2020 - I'm going to be working hard to protect their re-election. We also have quality candidates with deep experience running to unseat Democrats in swing districts across the country - I'm going to be working hard to make sure we flip these seats red. As I do this, I need help from committed patriots like you to ensure I have the resources to help expand our conservative movement in Congress. Your money can go a long way, and I would appreciate anything you can donate so we can achieve our goal of growing our Republican majority in the House. You can donate at this link: | | == | Now, here's your brief. | | | BIDEN'S DOJ GOES AFTER WHISTLEBLOWER WHO WAS TRYING TO PROTECT KIDS | | == | Dr. Eithan Haim is a Texas doctor who took to heart his oath to do no harm. The left loves to champion a whistleblower, but when a doctor blows the whistle on the mutilation of children, Democrats conveniently forget their 'principles.' Dr. Haim blew the whistle on transgender surgeries taking place at Texas Children's Hospital. When he came forward, he said he felt it was his responsibility as a doctor to expose the sex change procedures on children that the hospital told the public was not taking place. Now, Dr. Haim is being prosecuted by the Biden Administration. Flat out -- this prosecution should not be happening; that's obvious to anyone following this story. But unfortunately, Dr. Haim is being prosecuted because of Biden's politicized DOJ. They're looking to make an example of him so that no one with a different viewpoint steps out of line. That's why I am demanding answers into the reasoning behind this investigation from the Department of Justice and the Department of Health and Human Services, and any communication that took place within the Biden Administration in the lead up to this investigation. Americans do not want to see the next generation mutilated - that's what this fight is about. | | | HOLDING GARLAND IN CONTEMPT | | == | The left is predictably losing their minds over our vote this week to hold Attorney General Garland in contempt of Congress for his refusal to turn over the audio recording of the Department of Justice's interview with Joe Biden in the classified documents case. But this is the basic function of checks and balances within our system of government - Congress has an oversight authority over the executive branch. We've asked for the recordings, we've subpoenaed the executive branch, and when they still refuse to hand over the recordings it's our job to hold the Attorney General in contempt. Now, why do we want these recordings? It's not because of "naked partisanship" as the left has claimed, and it's not to "embarrass Biden" to show how he's old and doddering. We don't need an audio recording to know that Joe Biden is old, doddering, and doesn't have the mental faculties that we expect from a president - we can see that every single day. The reason we want these recordings is to establish intent, and to answer the basic questions: what was Joe Biden's intent behind his mishandling of classified documents? Did Joe Biden intentionally keep those documents? Did he know that they were clearly not being stored in a secure manner? Did he do all of this with the intent to talk about the classified material with his biographer? These are the questions we are trying to answer. The audio recording will help us answer these questions. And the fact that Attorney General Garland refuses to turn over these recordings after Congress lawfully requested them warrants that he be held in contempt of Congress, which is why I voted for it. | | | ON SOCIAL MEDIA | == | == | == | | | NEWS | == == == | That's it for this week's campaign brief. Peter, our
pro-peace ceasefire movement isn’t the only thing on the line in this

New Deal so the U.S. would take the bold, urgent action needed to address
the climate crisis. Fellow Justice Democrats Jamaal Bowman and Cori Bush
are two of the Green New Deal’s earliest and biggest supporters, who
rallied the support needed to see some of its critical points come to
light through the 2021 Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act. Jamaal has
since introduced the Green New Deal for Public Schools, while Cori is
leading the Green New Deal for Cities.

Here’s the problem: Our Green New Deal champions are facing massive
primary challenges from less progressive candidates who don’t support the
Green New Deal. AIPAC is fueling the fight, and they’re dropping tens of
billions of dollars from right-wing donors to set our movement back.

Here’s our solution: We must re-elect ALL members of our progressive bloc
to achieve the Green New Deal, Medicare For All, and many other
progressive cornerstone policies. We can’t afford to lose some of the
boldest and most outspoken progressives in Congress at a critical time
like this.

We need you with us, Peter.

Let’s out-organize the corporate interests and uber-wealthy Republicans

**This week I released my outline to expand learning opportunities for children across the 603: A Granite Strong Education Plan**
Having grown up in a low-income single-parent household, I understand firsthand the importance of educational choices for New Hampshire families. As Senate President, I drove the passage of the inital Education Freedom Accounts legislation. As Governor, I am committed to continuing on that track, ensuring every New Hampshire child has more educational opportunities than I had.
I will pursue a comprehensive approach to strengthening our public education system as Governor, making it easier for parents to access alternative options such as private and homeschooling. Additionally, I will advocate for parents to have an active role in their children's education, providing them with the necessary tools to collaborate effectively with educators. **Together, we can build a Granite Strong Education system in the 603.**

body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
Happy Flag Day! 🇺🇸 In honor of our great American flag, make sure you check out today's fun fact and quote below. Also, happy 78th birthday to President Donald Trump! This is the Mountain Minute for Friday, June 14, 2024.
- Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[Eight gun-control bills were passed by Colorado's legislature and signed by the governor. Here's a look.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Gov. Jared Polis signed into law [eight bills passed](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) by the legislature this year that tighten Colorado's gun statutes.
[Colorado Ceasefire](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), a nonprofit that calls for tougher gun regulations, says that's a legislative-session record for the state.
The laws [impose new requirements](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) on people obtaining concealed carry permits, the way firearms must be stored in vehicles and how weapons and ammunition are sold.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[What's on my ballot? Seven Senate races are opposed in primary election](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* There are [seven opposed Colorado Senate races](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for the upcoming primary elections, with four for the Republicans and three for the Democrats.
* Democrats currently hold a 23-12 majority in the Colorado Senate and are [one seat away from a supermajority](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
* The Colorado Senate, composed of 35 seats, will have [18 seats on the ballot ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)this primary, with the senators elected to a maximum of two, 4-year terms.
* Voters' choices in the primaries will depend on their [party registration](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and the specific Senate district races available on their ballots.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**['It works': Colorado's wolf conflict coordinator, ranchers find common ground](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)[DENVER7 NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado's Wolf Conflict Coordinator and local ranchers have been testing out [non-lethal measures such as fladry](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)--a line of flags intended to deter wolves--as a means to try and protect livestock during vulnerable periods like calving.
* Only a few ranchers in northern Colorado have adopted this method because of [skepticism about its practicality](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
* While the state provides some compensation for livestock losses due to wolves, ranchers express concerns over the financial and emotional impacts of [wolf predation](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) on their operations.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[House GOP holds AG Garland in contempt of Congress over withholding Hur's Biden tapes](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [POLITICO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* House Republicans voted to hold [Attorney General Merrick Garland in contempt](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) of Congress with a 216-207 vote, highlighting deep partisan divisions.
* The resolution cites Garland's [refusal to release audio](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) from President Biden's interview about mishandled classified documents, which the Justice Department argues could jeopardize future investigations.
* Concerns have been raised about the potential misuse of the audio and its negative impacts on ongoing inquiries. The contempt citation against Garland is largely symbolic and [unlikely to lead to prosecution](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) due to Biden's assertion of executive privilege and the political dynamics at play.
* This action [intensifies existing conflicts](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) between House Republicans and the DOJ, amidst a broader impeachment inquiry into Biden's family business dealings.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Colorado Libertarians don't plan to submit national party's presidential ticket to state's ballot](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado's Libertarian Party has decided [not to submit its presidential nominees](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), Chase Oliver and Mike ter Maat, to the state's November ballot, citing misalignment with the party's core values.
* The decision leaves open the possibility of [nominating someone else](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or listing "none of the above" for the presidential candidate on Colorado ballots.
* The party criticized Oliver for actions like wearing a mask and celebrating a socially distanced Thanksgiving during the pandemic, and ter Maat for his responses to political issues, which they felt [did not align](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) with Libertarian principles. Colorado Libertarians also disagreed with Oliver's stance on [gender-affirming care](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), opposing the view that it should be a decision between parents and children.
* The state party has expressed its disappointment with the [national Libertarian ticket](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and called for its decertification unless it realigns with the state party's principles.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Denver Public Schools to consider asking taxpayers for nearly $1 billion bond](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER7 NEW](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)S
* Denver Public Schools (DPS) is considering a proposal to ask voters for nearly [$1 billion in bond funding](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for various school improvements.
* The [proposed bond](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) would finance maintenance, the construction of new schools and expansions, safety and technology enhancements, and upgrades to arts and athletics facilities.
* DPS's Chief of Operations emphasized the [use of an equity lens](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in selecting the projects, aiming to ensure all students have a conducive learning environment.
* If the DPS board approves the recommendations, the bond proposal will be [placed on the ballot](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for a public vote in November.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Walcher: The EPA's end run around the Supreme Court](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY GREG WALCHER, [GREGWALCHER.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) | COMMENTARY
|
---
_An "end run" was once a common football term, describing an offensive play in which the ball carrier runs around the end of the defensive line. But today it is more often used rhetorically to describe a strategic dodge, any maneuver to bypass, circumvent, or sidestep. It's more common in politics than in football._
__
_Many Westerners celebrated earlier this year when the Supreme Court finally declared once and for all that "Waters of the United States" (WOTUS) does not include every creek, pond, ditch, puddle, and parking lot drain in the country. EPA spent nearly a decade trying to use WOTUS as the regulatory tool for a vast expansion of federal jurisdiction, to include virtually all activity that touches any water, ignoring the plain language of the Clean Water Act of 1972, from which the WOTUS definition originates. It explicitly applies to America's major rivers, bays, and oceans - "navigable waters."_
__
_With such a clear ruling from the nation 's highest court, might one expect the EPA to get over itself and move on? On the contrary, we have learned to expect an "end run" around the courts and the law, precisely what is now happening._ __

**[Cooper: Is signature verification of mail-in ballots valid?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BOB COOPER | COMMENTARY | JUNE 12** _All mail-in voting systems use a process called signature verification to verify the person voting by mail is the voter registered to vote. In Colorado this process is based on comparing the signature on the outer ballot envelope with the digital signature images in a database called SCORE._

**🇺 🇸 DID YOU KNOW?** "Old Glory" is one of the most famous nicknames for the **American flag**.

The first U.S. flag to be called "Old Glory" was flown by an American sea captain in the 1820s and in the U.S. Civil War, the flag was hidden in a quilt to save it from being seized by Confederate forces. Today, the original "Old Glory" is part of the collection at the National Museum of American History in Washington, D.C..

#
Derek,
I am reaching out to express my wholehearted support for Malcolm Kenyatta in his bid for Auditor General + I’m asking you to join me in supporting his campaign. 💙
I’ve had the pleasure of working with Malcolm over the years, and he has a proven track record of:
* fighting for working families 💪
* advocating for marginalized communities 📣
* standing up for what is right ⚖️

I’ve seen Malcolm’s dedication to public service firsthand, and it’s why I have no doubt that he will serve the people of Pennsylvania with integrity and diligence as Auditor General.
But he needs your help, Derek. Malcolm is facing a tough battle against the incumbent Republican. **[Will you make a $5 contribution to Malcolm’s campaign right now to make sure his team has every resource they need to flip this seat in November?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240614?refcode=em20240614-9114&refcode2=9114_434096_ovKQKM&akid=9114%2E434096%2EovKQKM)**

Malcolm has consistently demonstrated his commitment to transparency, accountability, and fairness in all of his endeavors. As a fellow Pennsylvanian, Malcolm understands the unique challenges facing our Commonwealth, and he has the vision and expertise needed to effectively address them.
**As Auditor General, Malcolm will monitor how public $$ is spent – trying to catch any fraud or bull 💩!** He is committed to rebuilding the Bureau of School Audits and creating a Bureau of Labor and Worker Protections. He’s an innovative problem-solver and he brings people together to do it — *exactly* what PA needs in our next Auditor General.
**[Today, I am asking you to show your support for Malcolm’s campaign through a $5 donation. It’s the best way of doing our part to make sure Malcolm gets elected this year.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240614?refcode=em20240614-9114&refcode2=9114_434096_ovKQKM&akid=9114%2E434096%2EovKQKM)**

Thank you,
❤️ John

U.S. Senator from Pennsylvania

I also want to make this clear: I don’t expect you or anyone else to donate just because our fundraising slowed down at a bad moment.
I’m asking for your support because I’m hoping that, if I lay out why I’m so passionate about this team, this mission, and this work, you’ll believe in this cause strongly enough to contribute your hard-earned money toward its success.
**The fact is, I’m running for re-election proudly on my record of getting big things done for Kansas families.**
By prioritizing results over partisanship and extremism, we’ve saved Kansans on Medicare $620 per year on insulin, created over 20,000 clean-energy jobs here in KS-03, and brought in millions of dollars for rural communities in Kansas to expand broadband access, ensure clean water, and fix aging roads and bridges.
**I’m also proud to be breaking the mold for what people picture when they picture a member of Congress.**
Here’s a brief snapshot of my life before I started serving in Washington: I was raised by a single mom and was the first person from my family to attend college. I juggled multiple jobs to pay my way through school. I then worked in economic and community development on Native American reservations. And when I flipped a Republican-held seat, it made me the first LGBTQ+ Native American elected to Congress.
**And I’m proud to be fighting hard for our values every single day.**
We’re up against extremists who are trying to take away abortion rights, to make life harder for LGBTQ+ Americans, to reduce access to affordable health care, and to undermine our democracy. I’m not afraid to stand up to them and defend our fundamental freedoms — but the reality is, if we’re going to win this fight, we need to flip control of the House. _**And there’s no realistic world in which we flip control of the House without defending this battleground House seat here in KS-03.**_
[_**So if you’re with me in this fight, and you’re able to contribute, I’d be sincerely grateful if you could pitch in before our mid-month deadline tomorrow →**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86892608/479356220/277100409?refcode=email_061424_MM1&amounts=10,20,50,75,100,250,500&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNjJkMDY2Yi02NTJhLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NYPXvH7pBjJb1zS5Hp93Zp6wnfCsUhJVpHov5V2Ou3s=)

Have a great weekend,
-Sharice

People often ask me what separates me from Marsha Blackburn. **_A whole lot._** For starters, I’m not a bought-and-paid-for politician. I am running an honest campaign powered by you — the people. From the get-go, I vowed not to take a dime from corporate interests, and I’ve stuck to that promise. Marsha? She’s deep in the pockets of the gun lobby, big pharma, and Big Oil. She's spent _decades_ in Washington prioritizing special interests over the needs of everyday Tennesseans. Her record speaks volumes: Marsha pushed the Big Lie, attacked our reproductive rights, voted against contraception, and slashed taxes for the wealthy while the middle class picked up the tab. She’s as self-serving as they get. On the flip side, I’ve stood tall for the people of Tennessee as a former educator, fighting for students and families.
