This month marks 55 years since the New York City Police Department raided Stonewall Inn, a bar in the city's Greenwich Village and a safe haven for the LGBTQ+ community.

Several brave Americans, led by Black and Brown trans activists, fought back against police violence and harassment. Demonstrations throughout the city happened over the span of six days, kick-starting the modern LGBTQ+ movement for equal rights.

Stonewall is a story of those who came before us and put everything on the line, demanding to be treated with dignity and respect. Those who bravely stood up and spoke out so that others wouldn't have to live in fear or silence.

I’m a German wire-haired pointer and proud bird dog. If you don’t know me, you probably know my human. His name is Ryan Busse and he’s running for Governor of my favorite place in the world: Montana! There are so many things I love about Montana — for starters, our public lands, our wildlife (especially game birds), and all of the amazing people I get to meet! But my human tells me that Governor Gianforte is trying to take away all of the things that make Montana special, and that makes me want to howl. | | Good morning, Peter, and sorry if the subject line of this email scared you, but I wanted to reach out and give you an update on some strange and concerning things my opponent, Joe McGraw, keeps talking about. McGraw is a MAGA extremist who said he prayed for the overturn of Roe, thinks Democrats are the “antichrist,” and spreads racist conspiracy theories. [**Please chip in to power us toward our $15,000 goal by Sunday night, and push back against incoming attacks from our MAGA opponent.**](http://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/5bKVMWUF5epjCWs--u8jAg~~/AAUS1gA~/RgRoTvUJP0TkaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2VzLXEyLTIwMjQ_) | ****[Donate](http://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/5bKVMWUF5epjCWs--u8jAg~~/AAUS1gA~/RgRoTvUJP0TkaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2VzLXEyLTIwMjQ_)****

And why is that? Well, McGraw thinks the church needs to get more involved in politics. He even said, **“There is no separation between church and state.”** Clearly, he has no interest in defending the Constitution because he’s never read it.

I wish we could dismiss all of this, but our polling has this race tighter than ever.

name: Team Cornel West 2024
subject: An Interview With Dr West and Lauren Jauregui
body:
The Progressive Voice We Need: Dr. Cornel West

| | | [ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=interview_with_lauren_jauregui&n=1)
---
---
Dear Peter, We are excited to share a compelling conversation between Lauren Jauregui (formally of the group, Fifth Harmony) and Dr. Cornel West, highlighting the urgent need for a new progressive leader in America. This engaging discussion emphasizes the critical issues facing our nation and the unique solutions Dr. West brings to the table.
---
[ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/r?u=_X1YtK1E-fhMWLMPEV96fehIbS-wRUfCcemrFPMltix-IdJEqWFiqnxALQuEhJgO&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=interview_with_lauren_jauregui&n=2)
---
**Why Dr. Cornel West?** Dr. West is a transformative figure in the progressive movement, advocating for justice, equality, and truth. His extensive career as a philosopher, theologian, and activist makes him the ideal candidate to lead us towards a more equitable future.
---
| [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/r?u=_X1YtK1E-fhMWLMPEV96fehIbS-wRUfCcemrFPMltix-IdJEqWFiqnxALQuEhJgO&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=interview_with_lauren_jauregui&n=3 "WATCH FULL INTERVIEW") [WATCH FULL INTERVIEW](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/r?u=_X1YtK1E-fhMWLMPEV96fehIbS-wRUfCcemrFPMltix-IdJEqWFiqnxALQuEhJgO&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=interview_with_lauren_jauregui&n=3)
---
**Key Points from the Conversation:**
* **Beyond the Duopoly:** Lauren Jauregui discusses the limited media coverage of third-party candidates and the necessity of exploring options beyond the Republican and Democrat duopoly. She highlights the need for a leader who truly represents the people, not corporate interests.
* **Historical Struggle for Justice:** Dr. West reflects on the historical and ongoing struggle for justice, emphasizing the importance of moral consistency and advocating for equality across all demographics, including race, gender, and sexual orientation.
* **Grassroots Movement:** Dr. West stresses the significance of grassroots organizing and the power of collective action. He calls for a movement that prioritizes the needs of the marginalized and oppressed, challenging the status quo and envisioning a more just society.

**The Importance of a Third-Party Candidate:** In a political landscape dominated by two major parties, the voices of the people often go unheard. The entrenched systems of power and corporate influence within the Republican and Democratic parties have led to policies that prioritize the interests of the elite over the needs of the many. This duopoly stifles real change and perpetuates systemic injustices.
---
---
## **Dr West's Vision**
---
Dr. West’s campaign is built on the foundation of truth and justice. He envisions an America where:
* [**Economic Justice:**](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/platform?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=interview_with_lauren_jauregui&n=4) The wealth disparity is addressed, and economic policies prioritize the needs of the working class over corporate greed.
* [**Racial Equality:**](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/platform?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=interview_with_lauren_jauregui&n=5) Systemic racism is dismantled, and all individuals have equal opportunities and rights.
* [**Environmental Stewardship:**](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/platform?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=interview_with_lauren_jauregui&n=6) The environment is protected, and sustainable practices are implemented to ensure a healthy planet for future generations.

---
---
---
[ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/donate?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=interview_with_lauren_jauregui&n=7)
---
**How You Can Help:**
* **Donate:** Support Dr. West’s campaign to bring about real change. Your contribution helps us challenge the entrenched systems of power and advocate for a more just and equitable America.

---
| [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/donate?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=interview_with_lauren_jauregui&n=8 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/donate?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=interview_with_lauren_jauregui&n=8)
---
* **Spread the Word:** Share this message with your friends, family, and network. Encourage others to join us in this critical movement for justice.

---
This is a pivotal moment in our nation’s history, and your support is crucial. Together, we can build a future that reflects the best of America. **In eternal love and solidarity,**
The West-Abdullah 2024 Campaign Team
---

body:
Congress must take immediate action to reinstate a ban on bump stocks
#

We’re outraged.
**This morning, the Supreme Court struck down ATF’s bump stock ban.**
This rule was enacted in 2017 after a mass shooter—who was armed with AR-15s accessorized with bump stocks—opened fire at the Route 91 Harvest music festival in Las Vegas. Within minutes, over 1,000 rounds were fired, killing 60 people and injuring over 400 others.
**Bump stocks turn semi-automatic weapons into fully automatic machine guns. They should be illegal.** Yet the Supreme Court’s decision stated that a firearm equipped with a bump stock does not meet the definition of a machine gun under federal law. The court’s decision is reckless and dangerous.
**Justice Sonia Sotomayor said it best in her dissent: "When I see a bird that walks like a duck, swims like a duck, and quacks like a duck, I call that bird a duck."**
Congress must take immediate action to reinstate a ban on bump stocks. Lives are at risk.
[**Will you sign our petition right now to demand that Congress takes action to reinstate a federal ban on bump stocks?**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_bumpstocks_pet_june24/?source=em240614-1-30&refcode2=8309.3935704.U4F3pY&akid=8309%2E3935704%2EU4F3pY)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_bumpstocks_pet_june24/?source=em240614-1-30&refcode2=8309.3935704.U4F3pY&akid=8309%2E3935704%2EU4F3pY)**
Machine guns do not belong on our streets. This shouldn’t be a controversial statement.
Shame on the Supreme Court for making it one.
\- Team GIFFORDS

Justice Sonia Sotomayor said it best in her dissent: "When I see a bird that walks like a duck, swims like a duck, and quacks like a duck, I call that bird a duck." Congress must take immediate action to reinstate a ban on bump stocks. Lives are at risk. Machine guns do not belong on our streets. This shouldn’t be a controversial statement. Shame on the Supreme Court for making it one. \- Team GIFFORDS Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. www.Giffords.org

body:
We got this far thanks to your support |
---
| | Dear Peter,
---
| While we didn’t get the result we wanted, I want to extend my deepest gratitude to all of our supporters for their unwavering dedication throughout this incredible journey. Together, we fought a hard battle, leaving nothing on the table, and I am profoundly thankful for the enthusiasm and vigor with which you championed our campaign.

This was a very tight race, and we faced significant challenges every step of the way. Your commitment and hard work have not gone unnoticed, and I am forever grateful for the sacrifices you made.

As we close this chapter, our focus must shift towards the important tasks ahead. We must work diligently to secure State seats to uphold the Governor’s veto and win Federal races to support President Trump’s efforts to rectify the critical issues facing our nation.

One key initiative we must pursue is the implementation of Voter ID laws and reevaluating the system of automatic mail-in ballots, which not only imposes significant costs on our state but has seen limited engagement, with only 10-15% voter turnout in the primaries. We need to stop ranked choice voting which is on the ballot this November as well.

I urge everyone to rally behind our Republican candidates in the upcoming elections. Let’s support them wholeheartedly to ensure they cross the finish line successfully.

[](http://links.primaryupdate.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=74268af8da7643f9992f8260985e9061&_e=vSmmGU_I6PQi6jucsPs22z578XzO_s0-6pPUAIamU0OmxXtIkFn7-0KXe844nm2EtEE6GysaQN-va-FNu0x25bNNb8GTJ71viwIY8KrhztwtbHNS3GhvoKGNv_biGHhTIwgo_VqOTpdd0DAmYcMy4e7eogtCtOilTXks_yNY2hgu3YCdr3hIy-bMNintj65ghs_n-wVLQUzFw1PyzZfYW6D0gS8YrYbW9y9lx2xHhCv4eJBovsBEXFo0qfSRrW41JtoRKQDN6rLKeinew3zWsQ%3D%3D)
I want to take a moment to remind you of my journey to the U.S. Senate, the important le ssons I have learned along the way, and why I continue to believe wholeheartedly in our beloved state.

My father, a World War II veteran, left school during the Great Depression to join the Army. Though he only had a ninth grade education, he built a career as a hard-working cement finisher. My mother, a dedicated voter who never missed an election, instilled in me the importance of civic duty.

From my parents, I inherited an unwavering love for this country that I have proudly carried throughout my life. It's something I strive to keep alive in Wyoming.

Later, in medical school, I learned the importance of having a plan before taking action, a lesson that has proven invaluable in both my medical career and my service as your senator. Just as in surgery, effective leadership requires a clear vision and a strategic approach to problem-solving.

As you may know, I am sometimes referred to as _"Wyoming's doctor,"_ but to be honest, that is what I have always strived to be as your senator. I have wholeheartedly dedicated myself to serving the state, addressing its challenges, and making it the best it can be.

**_Whether it's advocating for our veterans, championing American energy security, or safeguarding our borders, I've always strived to be a voice for all Wyoming people. Your concerns are my concerns, and your aspirations are my aspirations._**

As we look towards the future, I'm confident that Wyoming has the potential to be an even stronger, more prosperous state. **[But it will require strong leadership, a clear vision, and your continued support.](http://links.primaryupdate.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=74268af8da7643f9992f8260985e9061&_e=vSmmGU_I6PQi6jucsPs22z578XzO_s0-6pPUAIamU0OmxXtIkFn7-0KXe844nm2EtEE6GysaQN-va-FNu0x25bNNb8GTJ71viwIY8KrhztwtbHNS3GhvoKGNv_biGHhTCpXgVrCa6acCeXTbdojx0WyPwgMiJCc8jE4ctqvhTR8kYbd_nw_tmqWYgvCYOCirkECGuR91uryGxcjELj08ohj4Pn6WDkfyg2bDQVotCnyoSGfsbn2J0MW7j0ndtfqjg1_ggS-2IafsPZZ2ZIjuwQ%3D%3D)**

Already, your support has been instrumental in my journey, and I promise to continue fighting for the issues that matter most to Wyoming families.

Sincerely,
Senator John Barrasso [CHIP IN FOR A STRONG WYOMING](http://links.primaryupdate.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=74268af8da7643f9992f8260985e9061&_e=vSmmGU_I6PQi6jucsPs22z578XzO_s0-6pPUAIamU0OmxXtIkFn7-0KXe844nm2EtEE6GysaQN-va-FNu0x25bNNb8GTJ71viwIY8KrhztwtbHNS3GhvoKGNv_biGHhT0vJ_FpPBvVHFsHtYFMDLGdWXvN-aSr2jXP84K67UaHVcEyZRGEoN6AAENviUlJSMTJwu1pK0PZd6HlQYRsgpNthXHmPqyikGaC7QK_VI0R35QupEgME6GzVOVHZ0t-ZbWluh89yqQOghhrX17pVv_g%3D%3D)

Peter, when I was elected to Congress, I became the first openly gay person of color in Congress.

Today, there’s _**only 9** _LGBTQ+ Members of Congress out of 400+ in the House.

And as you can imagine, it’s not easy being in such a small minority. Especially when _**the other side doesn’t think you deserve the same rights**_.

It’s why I take my job so seriously. Because I am one of the few representatives who can fight for LGBTQ+ rights with personal conviction.

—So when Republicans spread transphobic hate, **I fight back.**
—When Republicans attack young LGBTQ+ students, **I fight back.**
—And when Republicans block critical legislation like the Equality Act, **I fight back.**

But Peter, until we flip the House, _Republicans will continue to hamper LGBTQ+ rights, abortion rights, voting rights, and more._

name: Dan Goldman
subject: June is Gun Violence Awareness Month
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Dan Goldman for New York**
body:
|
#
---
Peter, When I first ran for Congress, I made a promise that I would be a relentless advocate for combating gun violence and holding gun manufacturers accountable. Now, as the Vice Chair of the House Gun Violence Prevention Task Force and the Chair of the Dads Caucus Gun Violence Prevention Working Group, I can assure you that promise remains true. **[Please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me continue fighting for commonsense gun legislation in Congress>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86901900/479387101/916371601?refcode=AU_DSG_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240614_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDA4NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMTQxMTIxNi03MTJhLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rZIem5ACspgoYkhCnc3ELaU_RQ6dbFm51PwCz7Ci7FI=)** — **_Every day in the United States, people who should not have access to guns shoot 327 people, 23 of whom are children._** Gun-related tragedies have become so commonplace in our country that we risk becoming desensitized to the devastation these events reap on our communities. I recently joined Moms Demand Action to kick off Gun Violence Awareness Month by rallying to honor victims and survivors of gun violence and to stress the importance for parents, no matter their political party, to stand up for our kids' safety. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86901901/479387102/916371601?refcode=AU_DSG_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240614_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDA4NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMTQxMTIxNi03MTJhLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rZIem5ACspgoYkhCnc3ELaU_RQ6dbFm51PwCz7Ci7FI=) We know that an overwhelming majority of voters, including Republicans and gun owners, believe in universal background checks and other commonsense legislation opposed by the gun lobby — yet the Republican Party shows more loyalty to the gun lobby than their own children. **The NRA gave me an “F” rating when I first ran for Congress in 2022, and I’ve proudly worn it on my sleeve.** I won’t stop fighting back against Republicans in Congress who are irrational obstacles to protecting our communities. name: Michaela (Team McBride)
subject: McMentum!
body:
Hey team, Michaela here with a quick update on the campaign!
#
Hey team, Michaela here with a quick update on the campaign!
There’s been so much happening lately that it can be hard to keep up, so I wanted to make sure our grassroots supporters heard directly from me about how things are going.
[**The short version is that we’re in a very strong position, so if you don’t have time to read the full email and just want to make a quick donation to support Sarah’s campaign, you can click here to do that now!**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240614-1?refcode=em20240614-1&amount=5&refcode2=626_21716_uHrGc1&akid=626%2E21716%2EuHrGc1)
**First, thousands of people have joined Team McBride in recent weeks.** That includes over 400 people who have signed up to volunteer with the campaign — and we’ve _already_ knocked over 5,000 doors and made over 3,100 phone calls. I can’t wait to see what those numbers are like after Election Day!
**Second, Sarah earned a big endorsement this week from Delaware’s current U.S. Representative, Lisa Blunt Rochester!** She’s been such an effective leader in the House, and she’s going to make an amazing U.S. Senator — our whole team is so excited to have her on Team McBride.
**Third, Sarah is now the sole remaining Democratic candidate for Delaware’s open seat in Congress.** But we still can’t take that for granted. There are still a few weeks left before the filing deadline, so it’s still possible another candidate could enter the race!
**That’s why it’s so important that we keep the momentum going and prove to everyone just how strong this campaign is by raising as much as we can before our upcoming end-of-quarter deadline — and we need your help to do it!**
[**Will you pitch in $5 before tomorrow night to help us reach our mid-month goal and keep the McMentum going? We can’t do it without you!**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240614-1?refcode=em20240614-1&amount=5&refcode2=626_21716_uHrGc1&akid=626%2E21716%2EuHrGc1)

Thank you, team. More updates soon!
Michaela Kurinsky-Malos
Campaign Manager

name: Team Moore HQ
subject: A recap of the second quarter
body:
Friend,

It’s hard to believe that quarter two is coming to an end. So here’s a quick recap:

APRIL: We concluded the 446th legislative session early in April. Wes set out to accomplish four major goals: make Maryland safer, more affordable, and competitive, and continue to make this the state that serves. Through partnership, we were able to send Wes’s full legislative agenda to his desk — for the second year in a row.

MAY: We played catch-up on our fundraising after a three-month fundraising freeze. We’ve seen our team step up to the plate to help us close the gap, but unfortunately, we fell short of where we want to be.

NOW: We’re working to close the fundraising gap after the three-month fundraising freeze earlier this quarter.
We can’t afford to fall behind on our fundraising this quarter. What we raise this month will set the tone for the rest of the year.

Friend, help us catch up on our fundraising by adding a donation of $5 or more right now. We need to keep up our momentum through the rest of the summer and the fall. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20240614-1?refcode=em20240614-1]

clean_body: The Balint Organizing Corps (BOC) officially starts this Monday! | | Hi Peter, The Balint Organizing Corps (BOC) officially starts this Monday! After a successful inaugural summer last year, we’re gearing up to train and mentor the next generation of political change-makers in Vermont. I’m beyond excited to welcome the new BOC class and hit the ground running! = We were able to fund last summer’s inaugural BOC program with small-dollar contributions from supporters like you. But in order to fund the important work ahead of us this summer, I’m counting on this grassroots team to chip in. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = A little over two years ago, we set out to change the way we did politics: From the ground up, with courage and kindness. Together, we built a community-centered campaign dedicated to Vermont, allowing us to elect a queer middle school teacher from Brattleboro to be our state’s very first congresswoman! Through BOC, her signature program, Becca is sharing her wisdom and learnings with Vermont’s next generation of organizers. This six-week program will train and mentor young Vermonters and future campaign staffers who want to shape the future of our state by electing progressive, forward-thinking leaders to every level of public office. = We know that change doesn't happen with one person or campaign. It’s a team effort built cycle-over-cycle, and starts with planting the seeds of passion and political power in young people across Vermont. As we celebrate Flag Day, we honor the symbol of our nation's freedom, unity, and enduring spirit. The American flag represents the values we hold dear: liberty, justice, and the pursuit of happiness. | | As we celebrate Flag Day, I am filled with a deep sense of pride and gratitude for our nation's symbol of freedom and unity, my friend. As you know, Flag Day falls on June 14th and marks the anniversary of the adoption of the Stars and Stripes as the official flag of the United States. _But, we have something even more special to be proud of here in the Badger State._ **That's because the very first Flag Day was held here in Waubeka, Wisconsin in 1885!** Wisconsinites know that our flag is more than just a piece of fabric; it embodies the spirit of America. Our 13 stripes symbolize the original colonies that fought for our independence, while the 50 stars represent the states that make up our great nation. As we honor our flag today, let us also reflect on the unity and strength it represents and remember that we are all part of a larger story, one that is continually shaped by our collective efforts to build a Republic based on liberty and justice. _**[_**How much do you know about our flag? Take my Stars and Stripes trivia quiz and test your knowledge!**_](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=f9ef163c38f94024905cc6b5e55f222e&_m=f5b6179aa8554ff9a6b547586e008898&_e=DEhXwJ6etb0KvKh3Z02Q_Ro7JtP8jJd3IMgdfP-URYpicpgJIGq32WmuZSQ3xz24mlP1-eGGi-yN7ZCMjBjQIEHlxKFr0wLuh3tCizQcUx-4xiRYbAS6uy5IUS9d0jRib-7pUXV5eIarusOx2j54-7TPCxjsNMxxD1JMZLDs-CfM2lRrggVOo6WTUW-p072r2HUrRNLw70iJgSkjBytXJ9kdM4Flr66W-GM8ZRTxz0HwNI2OMVQ93osZdYZo3BD0H-TgnrXJVP-12SGpJaEA-lF9QUfmdvAqeZtxrfgoL1k%3D)**_ Happy Flag Day, **Glenn Grothman**

clean_body: | | | | | As we celebrate Flag Day, I am filled with a deep sense of pride and gratitude for our nation's symbol of freedom and unity, my friend. As you know, Flag Day falls on June 14th and marks the anniversary of the adoption of the Stars and Stripes as the official flag of the United States. But, we have something even more special to be proud of here in the Badger State. That's because the very first Flag Day was held here in Waubeka, Wisconsin in 1885! Wisconsinites know that our flag is more than just a piece of fabric; it embodies the spirit of America. Our 13 stripes symbolize the original colonies that fought for our independence, while the 50 stars represent the states that make up our great nation. As we honor our flag today, let us also reflect on the unity and strength it represents and remember that we are all part of a larger story, one that is continually shaped by our collective efforts to build a Republic based on liberty and justice. body:
Friend — Give me just a moment to tell you the story of a phone call that changed everything.
I’m Eugene Vindman. My brother Alex and I used to serve on the White House National Security Council. I was the senior ethics official on the Council.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86906743/479406221/1320819669?amount=3&refcode=UTS_FR_90DO_240614_1_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg5NDc2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjgwMGIxMzZjLTdiMmEtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=HKdOx5VD4d7ZN4OANLB8oTBK1127PnjQmfMSQy0PR-c=)
In 2019, Alex overheard a phone call in which President Trump attempted to extort our allies in Ukraine. Trump threatened to withhold military aid unless President Zelenskyy investigated his political rival.
After Alex reported the call to me, we both blew the whistle on Trump. We reported Trump’s corrupt phone call up the chain of command, and it led to his impeachment.
Even though the decision to blow the whistle on Donald Trump was the right thing to do, it cost my brother and me our military careers after the former-president retaliated against us. But I am not done serving.
**I’m running for Congress in Virginia to fight back against Trump and the far-right Republicans who enable his abuse of power and attacks on our Democracy.**
And more than that, I’m running to push our country forward across the board. To restore abortion rights everywhere, act on climate change, and lower costs for working families.
So here’s the deal. If we win Virginia’s 7th district, we win a highly competitive swing district and make it that much more likely that Democrats take back the House.
And if we take back the House, we can begin to make progress on those issues while safeguarding against any Republican attempts to roll back our rights.
So, with Virginia’s Primary Election Day just around the corner, please:
[_**Split a contribution between me and Upset the Setup to support my campaign for Congress. My brother Alex and I used to serve on the White House National Security Council. I was the senior ethics official on the Council. = In 2019, Alex overheard a phone call in which President Trump attempted to extort our allies in Ukraine. Trump threatened to withhold military aid unless President Zelenskyy investigated his political rival. After Alex reported the call to me, we both blew the whistle on Trump. We reported Trump’s corrupt phone call up the chain of command, and it led to his impeachment. Even though the decision to blow the whistle on Donald Trump was the right thing to do, it cost my brother and me our military careers after the former-president retaliated against us. But I am not done serving. I’m running for Congress in Virginia to fight back against Trump and the far-right Republicans who enable his abuse of power and attacks on our Democracy. Convention recap and Signature gathering!

| | [ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=JgyyvCfQwldlSeD7KJl_Ih7269o_4hwqOhPs1_PHvgI&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=june_statewide_call_invite&n=1)

Friday, June 14, 2024 |
### Tired of the Same Old things in politics?
Peter -- Join us Monday June 17th at 8pm for our Monthly Statewide call [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=MtBLw57MCBnd28lIl741u6P9-Hx0zs-QPm6VAaSuDh4Sdlc62t3OcWCnrBmB7tVtdrPWWqIK2Jr5L7IDADtVNA&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=june_statewide_call_invite&n=2) This is the time when all the work comes together. For 2 years, we've all been getting on calls, attending events, and supporting building a new party in PA. Now is the time to lean in and make it happen. We have candidates in races. We have systems to support those candidates. We have relationships to support us. We just need the core group of volunteers to make it all happen. The most urgent thing we've ever asked is for you to help us gather signatures. If everyone who received this email signed petition themselves, we'd be way over the signature goal. We know it's intimidating to ask people to sign a petition but if you're willing to print out a sheet, get your family and friends to sign it and mail it in, please reply to this email and we'll get you what you need. This is something real you can do to make a difference and build something new.
* * *
### Convention Recap
Thank you to everyone that made the convention such a success. We'll be talking about the highlights and the business that was done. Check out the youtube page to see videos of the event. | [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=_KeSraPW0gSlxEBMOvJrEpfPMB7uVBZkK7A1O5VOawVgzNtc2GhXIbWIDDZpgIuF&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=june_statewide_call_invite&n=3 "PA Forward Youtube") [PA Forward Youtube](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=_KeSraPW0gSlxEBMOvJrEpfPMB7uVBZkK7A1O5VOawVgzNtc2GhXIbWIDDZpgIuF&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=june_statewide_call_invite&n=3)
---
### State Chair Election
We also want to celebrate the reelection of our State Chair Christian Fyke at the convention. Christian is responsible for so much of the growth and stability since the beginning. Both in a front facing role and behind the scenes we're incredibly happy that he will remain in his current position for another term.

Peter, wanted to take a moment to wish you a Happy Pride Month!
LGBTQ+ Americans make our country better, and we’re all better off because of the contributions of queer folks.
We’ve made incredible strides towards equality over the past few decades, but we still have a long way to go. Republican-led legislatures across the country haven’t slowed down in their attempts to pass legislation discriminating against LGBTQ+ Americans - particularly our transgender brothers and sisters. So far in 2024, over 500 anti-LGBTQ+ bills have been introduced nationwide.
Peter, we have a lot of work to do.
As a staunch ally, I’ve spent my career fighting for the rights of queer Americans. From marriage equality to employment discrimination to access to medical care, I’ll never stop standing up for the LGBTQ+ community.
Happy pride!
Jennifer

subject: Happy Pride Month, Tennessee!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Tennessee House Democratic Caucus | Ronnie Glynn, Treasurer
body:
https://tnhousedems.com/ [https://tnhousedems.com/]
Hi Peter,
The Tennessee House Democrats wish you a happy Pride Month! Our legislators are honoring this month by renewing our commitment to advocate for policies that protect and uplift the LGBTQ+ community in our state legislature.
We celebrate the tireless efforts of those who have fought for generations in the hope of a more equal and just Tennessee. In honor of these trailblazers, LGBTQ+ Tennesseans, and the next generation, we pledge to continue our fight.

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
Did you hear the latest update on our #TX07 race? Following Texas’ primary election runoffs, the field is set for the general election and Lizzie has a Republican opponent.
Like candidates before her, this new challenger has said she wants to repeal the Affordable Care Act, which would take away affordable health care options from more than 3 million Texans. Lizzie knows this is not right for the district, or for Texas. She has fought to expand health care access for Texans, to make it more affordable, and, of course, to protect the freedom for us to make our own reproductive health care decisions.
We know we can’t take anything for granted. That’s why we’re going to work as hard as we always have to tell voters about the work Lizzie is doing in Congress—including how she’s helped lower prescription drug costs and fought back against extreme abortion bans— but people need to know Lizzie has an opponent.
I’m keeping a close eye on our numbers, especially right now when we’re about two weeks out from the next FEC reporting deadline. Reaching our fundraising benchmarks ensures we can run a strong field operation, send mail to voters, and run digital and print ads. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240614?refcode=lpfe240614]

body:
The Big Deal in our House TodayToday, June 14, is Flag Day, but it is also my wife, April’s Birthday! She loves our country, and our flag has always | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us2.campaign-archive.com/?e=5a45ee1154&u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=4a9cef3ecb)
---
| |
---
| Peter,

The Big Deal in our House Today

Today, June 14, is Flag Day, but it is also my wife, April’s Birthday! She loves our country, and our flag has always meant a lot to her. Having a husband who has been serving as a State Delegate and then runs for Congress has been hard on her at times...but her support for me has been unwavering.

We pray about most decisions we make as a family, and April and I were both certain that God was calling us to run for Congress this past February. She has been working right alongside me ever since.

April is a retired CPA, she speaks French fluently, and she runs our summer swimming league, HASS, tirelessly. She has poured her energy into raising our 3 kids, and they are great. She is great. I am so thankful and blessed.

**Will you help me to wish April a Happy Birthday today, June 14, by donating any amount today?** She is one of the most practical people I know, and she actually told me that she would love to see a few donations in her honor. _** End your donation in $.14, and I will be able to tell her that it is for her!**_
---
| [Help me Wish April a Happy Birthday!](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=ccbc8bc89e&e=5a45ee1154 "Help me Wish April a Happy Birthday!")
---
| | Here are the cookies that she has painstakingly made for the silent auction tonight. Did I mention that April is a great cook? I hope you’ll take a moment to send any about over with a $.14 at the end. If you know her, you know that April’s smile lights up a room, and I know that this gesture will make her smile.

She is kind of The Big Deal in our house, and I am thankful to be able to celebrate her Birthday today.

On Flag Day,
Neil

P.S. April made the Elephant Cookies for the Silent Auction tonight. It is not too late to sign up, please use the button below to come to the event or pay at the door. You may not want to miss this!

The State Party will provide the most important fact - a kernel of truth - from the week. ** INDems Awarded $70,000 From the Democratic National Committee (DNC) ICYMI: On Monday, June 10, the DNC announced it would be awarded $70,000 to INDems to help the team break the Republican supermajority in the Statehouse. The entire INDems team is extremely grateful and proud to have our hard work recognized by the DNC. As we continue moving toward our goal, we encourage everyone to and turn out this November - only four more seats need to be flipped to break their State House supermajority, and bring more balance to the Hoosier State. Rokita Continues Crusade Against Hoosier Women and Doctors On Wednesday, June 12, an article published by the noted that the Indiana Department of Health (IDOH) was being sued by an anti-abortion group for halting the release of terminated pregnancy reports (TPRs), and that Rokita has rejected the IDOH’s choice of attorneys. Instead, he appointed his own pre-approved counsel that was contracted with his office, denying the IDOH the representation it deserves to argue the case. The IDOH decided to stop releasing individual TPRs last December due to the infrequent rate that abortions are performed in Indiana following the passage of the abortion ban. As a result, health officials became concerned that the reports could be “reverse engineered” to identify the women who underwent the procedure, putting their safety at risk. We have a responsibility to protect these individuals, and Rokita’s failure to do so is an affront to their privacy. Hoosiers, it’s time we retire Rokita to ensure women can live without fear of retribution from the far-right. Peter, I’m writing to humbly ask if you can make one a donation before our campaign’s mid-month deadline hits tomorrow at midnight.
It’s an important milestone as we approach our official FEC deadline on June 30th, and it would mean a lot to know we have enough in the tank to hit our goals.

| | ****Honoring Our Flag 🇺🇲****
---
| |
---
Stars, stripes, and an enduring symbol of unrivaled freedom. In recognition of Flag Day, I think it’s important to reflect on the grand old flag and everything she stands for. Nothing is by accident when it comes to this [iconic American symbol](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=ca94a7409f444930bd2f0a46a39a0fc9&_e=pQj2AbE-92kb9C-A6w-xEVrc1lnnCUcZcEMlXhYG0OttF4e4i8I2LuNBEgADVGVvbvvKlKx4n4Jg_F_bZhDp2B11ZwUswcs8Eml_K0kkkJVP99Ib_3SzdcJ9g2F_TXdv3qDsjPr-RvFZtVHLyBgxEbEu-v-mOwlDTGLXNzatN3iCAHzZw88PrdKlv5Mw9oyfedIjId5FCECu3ARrvGddDeXvoDJ7_A8_EjtaWc_6EML8dpNdo_mg-vk56Fi736lT). The stripes represent the 13 original colonies, and there’s a star for all 50 states of the Union. Even the colors have meaning: red for hardiness and valor, white for purity and innocence, and blue to represent vigilance, perseverance, and justice. It feels like there has never been a more crucial time to recommit ourselves to these collective values. There’s a lot of wacky stuff happening in our country lately, and some folks are trampling all over our precious flag—both figuratively and literally. We’ve watched [anti-Israel protesters](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=ca94a7409f444930bd2f0a46a39a0fc9&_e=pQj2AbE-92kb9C-A6w-xESN3brpIup5xOPLY5MrVn6S8DmW9m1zcZtBm0WlcurRNCy-QQEbkMh814SlScZQb_-gx4_JjshMhb5-61tKHnqdzpmP3z_Pcfsfn7YKJ3W_FYEnMfXwzDtKKf5TFmyZ3ifjBO4hMXqzj3ztbCc7HVnGUAJzi0TP4faZGwgShKxBGhZKPOJuT-XnpqLMsELPiQGh5AEUSpeD9igSwL1ClCDavsKONLZu27qqAjTxWL5QbUJAVQgno-Rn1Cy0DnRk2R-XT0XIqh94AbWyrkxmj9UJgDjhB7TNo28JXJV2jts_uMrjptB2xA2gtRdTv0gJ8zg%3D%3D) take it down to fly a Palestinian flag, cheering when Old Glory hit the ground. Earlier this month, a [Colorado woman](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=ca94a7409f444930bd2f0a46a39a0fc9&_e=pQj2AbE-92kb9C-A6w-xESN3brpIup5xOPLY5MrVn6RDeICCnQgeZdDeHtk96gQIj-Z_QkZZ7hyjfwIYCtkrYuFZdr04_HGow7QNyZw-hkQVqVVVN2Vio1GLjJwFd_TfOk55Cl2PTPegorlLjZRL0YOY4dAlclI-0lnqinECKMxaxvH8OpLe3nvKZ7iiKWICvTg2JJ6BIwtGv_rOFzqeQd_J6EKe7vpEbIaIKQ7WFh342AK03323_2vMtovzufSGzu5zNBLCWtQYFT9HuUOCdv95jkzn2xLKuNhBoVnQqjc%3D) ripped seven flags to shreds outside a police department—flags that were placed in honor of fallen officers. All this begs the question: Have these people lost their dadgum minds? Perhaps it's rare these days, but I’ve always held our flag in the highest regard. Back when I was Knox County Mayor, I even established collection points for to-be-retired American flags that were no longer usable to ensure they were [properly and respectfully disposed of](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=ca94a7409f444930bd2f0a46a39a0fc9&_e=pQj2AbE-92kb9C-A6w-xEY-sdT0u7ZslUnuP11nvWxTVO8B_Z6TeHfLEoZaKW-wM7qcrhHOri1IIWJfxWJxyiylbL6LCVFaFWD4NKf5NAZaJZzxVO9Hnlma0vshTaCYZMzNK950OWHNkm_YnQMb2MFmJRUM90A55VePq_gbJCXThgHBxsSm3szLWQ1MqXfjO1fvfwqD-_Q0LrdB8Mrr2PNB4WHZCUQpr2VgmDpFBR4XVwuTBPmC8bMssKrh1hDgqphJT1K4eGMX-j7pgqNjm6w%3D%3D). Our brave men and women of the armed forces go to battle under the flag, and those taken from us too soon come home in caskets draped in it. I’m reminded of this every day as I look up at the unfurled and framed flag that hangs in my office—the same one that covered my Uncle Roy’s casket back in the D-Day era. Even after so many years, it never fails to move me, reminding me that such powerful memories are shared by many of us. Whether the Star-Spangled Banner is flying high at a parade, a funeral, or on your home's front porch, she's always a sight to see—a perfect symbol of American pride and a beacon of freedom and opportunity for the rest of the world.

| | One of the best spots to cool off this summer can be found right here in East Tennessee!
Norris Lake was just ranked fourth on USA Today’s list of the [10 best lakes for swimming](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=ca94a7409f444930bd2f0a46a39a0fc9&_e=pQj2AbE-92kb9C-A6w-xEYThZaxyC57TV2VDHxBcxbt5GSTgEqx6XJsLVOQUWdAaUeiI87SeINIiJMmdlfYKlGwvFrfxZ2wNMjAfRtrVlTZWkOqpy-U6E7R2uLLIvsOmKQDzQIegsVcLraZwFNG3jDVdQm9jO7GObTlmVzBj7QS0ZN92YZBQYBMT-XaAqKk564zw1u2KtNMKK8x9iCtrBLlaZAOeFRHHH4dk4sNmiMkLmT8t4LIBT2y3Q1S4jTAyMqpxD7dGSOB-v4bqm5T8TrcVZN2sedZNJpAkePcde7WulXQUclzEE4mNL3dVfhosY30mtuC4PQtaAjzjDMcUYA%3D%3D), even beating out two of the actual Great Lakes. For all of us East Tennessee locals, we already knew this reservoir is a gem—but I’m glad the rest of America is taking note. If you haven’t been out to Norris Lake, I’d suggest you put it at the top of your summer to-do list. It’s just 20 miles north of Knoxville and features a whopping [800 miles of shoreline](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=ca94a7409f444930bd2f0a46a39a0fc9&_e=pQj2AbE-92kb9C-A6w-xEQkOYPmOE80WIaF72D4m-ACSz7VfrEzK1nVYJCTEUF1lVzsk6Ohxt9Mbsma6v62ii1NRh1-3Pv1BIesjmyx4_HnMdVK1wwuZwnZDUqtGKCB1jGpD7sbd_QHXrP9--fjWu_U8EnXRFRkOIwm4c7Zz3jvHsQRBMI16FfSvCbtqtj6Cxg51waHRWZgBnFmyz1hnpot6m6KmPRWGOG5tCqsdhvU%3D) spanning five counties. Managed by the Tennessee Valley Authority, the lake began as a method of [flood control](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=ca94a7409f444930bd2f0a46a39a0fc9&_e=iaNDYcaIRaGqNvUXDXxV5ep_HZzJHBKYEA48FdMwS-h261vnJFnO10g-MMtOndKx55RhUpqk2oZAXVownApXVSDa4iCo2yy5UguOauX5E-YZMcJ0iEnexhBq5s-oIl6whjg1udvYSFN7PKpSt8nQsSPMOsasYifJ1gO0WPKyuCK6xMxp_iLrqOk4DXOsbM7l-8ftwJiUvBZxX-a1z138GA%3D%3D) in the 1930s. Today, the calm waters make it a perfect spot for everything from water skiing to fishing. Take a day off and experience the serene beauty and family-friendly activities Norris Lake offers. You won't be disappointed!

clean_body: TIMtalk will keep you updated on the important issues and goings-on in our campaign, in Tennessee, and in our country.| | | | | **Honoring Our Flag 🇺🇲 | | Stars, stripes, and an enduring symbol of unrivaled freedom. In recognition of Flag Day, I think it’s important to reflect on the grand old flag and everything she stands for. Nothing is by accident when it comes to this . The stripes represent the 13 original colonies, and there’s a star for all 50 states of the Union. Even the colors have meaning: red for hardiness and valor, white for purity and innocence, and blue to represent vigilance, perseverance, and justice. It feels like there has never been a more crucial time to recommit ourselves to these collective values. There’s a lot of wacky stuff happening in our country lately, and some folks are trampling all over our precious flag—both figuratively and literally. We’ve watched take it down to fly a Palestinian flag, cheering when Old Glory hit the ground. Earlier this month, a ripped seven flags to shreds outside a police department—flags that were placed in honor of fallen officers. All this begs the question: Have these people lost their dadgum minds? Perhaps it's rare these days, but I’ve always held our flag in the highest regard. Back when I was Knox County Mayor, I even established collection points for to-be-retired American flags that were no longer usable to ensure they were . Our brave men and women of the armed forces go to battle under the flag, and those taken from us too soon come home in caskets draped in it. I’m reminded of this every day as I look up at the unfurled and framed flag that hangs in my office—the same one that covered my Uncle Roy’s casket back in the D-Day era. Even after so many years, it never fails to move me, reminding me that such powerful memories are shared by many of us. Whether the Star-Spangled Banner is flying high at a parade, a funeral, or on your home's front porch, she's always a sight to see—a perfect symbol of American pride and a beacon of freedom and opportunity for the rest of the world. | | | | | An East Tennessee Treasure 🧡 | | | | Image courtesy of | | One of the best spots to cool off this summer can be found right here in East Tennessee! For all of us East Tennessee locals, we already knew this reservoir is a gem—but I’m glad the rest of America is taking note. If you haven’t been out to Norris Lake, I’d suggest you put it at the top of your summer to-do list. It’s just 20 miles north of Knoxville and features a whopping spanning five counties. Managed by the Tennessee Valley Authority, the lake began as a method of in the 1930s. Today, the calm waters make it a perfect spot for everything from water skiing to fishing. I am a veteran; I take our duty to those who serve very seriously. We cannot allow anyone who is under investigation for playing a role in the Jan. 6 attacks or who is at risk of being compromised in any way by our adversaries to have access to our nation’s dearest intelligence.
I wish this wasn’t necessary; I’d much prefer to see our progress on the National Defense Authorization Act or our record-low unemployment rates make headlines. But our national security is vital, and these representatives could jeopardize that every day. **The American people deserve better.**
I know this request of the speaker may make me more of a target for right-wing extremists. I don’t relish taking action against my fellow members, but I needed to be sure of the integrity of our institutions and the security of our intelligence. You can read more about my decision here:

name: Gavin Newsom
subject: The Supreme Court strikes again
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY CAMPAIGN FOR DEMOCRACY PAC
body:
Bump stocks make semi-automatic firearms act like fully automatic weapons. Full stop.

Friend -
Bump stocks make semi-automatic firearms act like fully automatic weapons. Full stop.
They were used by the Las Vegas shooter in 2017 – allowing the shooter to send off 90 shots in 10 seconds – killing 60 people and injuring over 400 more in the deadliest mass shooting in modern American history.
Months later, the Trump Administration Justice Department rightly banned bump stocks, a small step in the right direction.
**Today, the Supreme Court overturned that ban — effectively legalizing machine guns in this country.**
Let me say that again. Today the Supreme Court overturned a Trump Administration ban on bump stocks — effectively legalizing machine guns in this country.
Folks, this is just another example of why we need a Constitutional Amendment to make our communities safer from gun violence.
Republicans in Congress have refused to pass even basic gun safety reforms.
We have an out-of-control Supreme Court overturning century-old gun safety laws.
In the states, right-wing judges appointed by George Bush and Donald Trump are overturning commonsense gun safety laws proven to save lives.
California became the first state to call for a Constitutional Amendment on guns. We will not be the last.
As you read this, we are training volunteers and building organizing capacity in key states across the country to get that done. I have not - and will not - give up on this fight.
Today, I am asking for your support in that effort:

body:
Hi Peter,
I wanted to personally reach out and give you an update on our race.
When I set out to run again — after losing by one percentage point in 2022 — I wanted to make sure we did it right. That meant creating a comprehensive campaign strategy to reach critical swing voters in every corner of our district, and getting the national attention we missed out on last cycle.
With five months until Election Day, we’re on the way to making both those goals a reality. We’re recognized as one of the most competitive races in the country and getting support from big national organizations like the DCCC, Planned Parenthood, Sierra Club, and End Citizens United.
But competing with the Republican establishment behind my opponent is a major challenge. Mike Johnson’s PAC has already reserved almost $6 million in ads in our district.
I’m running for office because I want to be a voice for Arizona’s working families, veterans, and seniors. I will be a leader who fights for the issues that folks in AZ-06 care about, from reproductive rights to better-paying jobs — unlike my opponent, who is just a puppet for the far-right agenda.
Building a winning campaign takes a lot of work — and a lot of resources.
[June is a hugely important fundraising month for us. As we build up our campaign and field team for this summer, I have to ask: can you chip in to support our work before our quarterly fundraising deadline at the end of this month?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86910565/479417930/1131851138?refcode=X_061424_noform_act&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MjcwOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MzZiMThlMy04MTJhLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=iWHnQ6sUUW3KN_dIuEJuZ4MFsL4-naGJs7DPbDXdGzE=)
Whatever you can donate makes a huge difference in our work to flip the most competitive seat in Arizona blue.
Thank you so much.
Kirsten

#### Once a law about equality between the sexes, Title IX is being hijacked to discriminate against women.
---
| Dive into this latest op-ed by **Beth Ann Rosica **reacting to the Biden administration’s redefinition of “sex” in Title IX.

The Biden administration's new regulations, effective August 1, 2024, **allow biological males identifying as females to use women's and girl's facilities in schools**. Rosica contends this change threatens women's safety and rights, potentially **punishing women who oppose it**.

Citing the reversal of decades of progress in women’s rights achieved since Title IX's inception in 1972, Rosica poses a question – "where have all of the feminists gone?"

Friend,
Our Trump-endorsed opponent continues to spread her extreme and misleading views across South Texas.
In an interview a few days ago , she highlighted our communities for all of the wrong reasons, only furthering an agenda of division.
Vicente, on the other hand, has always had a positive vision for the future of our communities in South Texas.
When the people in places like Brownsville, Harlingen, Kingsville, and San Benito, think about the challenges facing them, they think of issues beyond just the border, like expanding Medicaid, improving public education, upgrading local infrastructure, and supporting small businesses.
Her extreme positions are not surprising, given that she is supported by some of the most extreme Republican voices in the country, including Ted Cruz ❗ and Dinesh D'Souza, not to mention convicted felon Donal Trump.
As your Congressman, Vicente has always worked with you and your family's well-being in mind, which is why we need your support to win what was Texas' closest congressional race.
Friend, we can't let a far-right extremist win in South Texas, especially if that means our communities' well-being are on the line—can you donate today to help us win what was once Texas' closest congressional district? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20240614_em_fr_b1_TV_NGP]
SUPPORT OUR EFFORTS [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20240614_em_fr_b1_TV_NGP]
With gratitude,
Team Vicente Gonzalez
Vicente Gonzalez, a life-long Democrat, is a candidate for Texas’ 34th U.S. Congressional District.
From humble beginnings, Vicente was raised in a military family. Through hard work and pure ganas, Vicente aimed to make something of himself. His mother stressed to him over and over again that education was the key that will open doors of opportunities. Vicente made the decision to get his life back on track by going back to school to get his GED, working and attending classes at community college, and earning his college degree alongside other military families at the Embry Riddle Aeronautical University on the Corpus Christi Naval Air Station. Vicente surpassed his and his parents' dreams when he graduated from Texas A&M School of Law, earning his Juris Doctorate degree.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20240614_em_fr_b1_TV_NGP [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20240614_em_fr_b1_TV_NGP]
While in law school, Vicente learned how government should work. Through his experience as a Congressional Intern in Washington, D.C., Vicente learned how government really works. After law school, Vicente didn’t stop learning, and continued his training in Negotiation at Harvard University School of Law.
Vicente started his business, the Law Offices of V. Gonzalez and Associates, in McAllen and married Lorena Saenz, a former teacher and administrator in Edinburg and McAllen schools. Vicente has focused his practice on fighting for a level playing field for working families wronged by corporations and insurance companies evading responsibility. Through several victories for our community, Vicente recovered millions in tax dollars for South Texas school districts after shady contractors misspent millions in bond money and put our children in physical danger.
Today, Vicente Gonzalez is fighting for our South Texas values in Congress as a member of the Committees on Financial Services and Foreign Affairs and the Select Committee on Economic Disparity and Fairness in Growth. Vicente has stood by our promise to veterans, helping constituents cut through red tape at the VA and working across the aisle to prevent the shameful deportation of our honorably discharged veterans. He’s working to lower prescription drug prices, protect the benefits and healthcare of seniors, and ensure that jobs and opportunities are there for all with the ganas to work.

**The 2024 Indiana Republican State Convention**
---
The Indiana GOP will host the 2024 Indiana Republican State Convention in downtown Indianapolis this weekend, Friday, June 14th and Saturday, June 15th. There are over 1,800 delegates from every county in Indiana coming together to make decisions that will have a lasting impact on our party. We at the Indiana GOP are working to ensure that this convention will be one of the most successful, secure, and timely State Conventions. We hope this will set the groundwork for future State conventions. Click [HERE](http://links.email.in-gop.com/u/click?_t=9a0b7d408bc44ce9bb6828c91a267dbf&_m=c1aeaca879244a6f96b7f76c05a155a8&_e=aCMAkVsxXPIjPwomkZOGwXkKUmqlRxVZooG-PtWGuGOSGed-C6MMPOCzeRgPfSEvXsew2F43zlA3Wwq0Ou5MuVnpKfaCg6HK6QwV2sTgmW9iqXWQ23C_WmKdl6atJfysixbKV8ZTmlstLFl_xYH6TGcK0HZSv-Kw1QdeDC7oQz0ZZEKO6DJWe6nqNVDOMcfOVYXiVh6y3gXwUc3gVRpe8KUThcsWwiLFCaDSmO6tJuc%3D) to learn more about the 2024 Convention. What is the Indiana Republican State Convention?
* Indiana code and Republican Party rules, specifically party rule 7-23, makes it clear that there are two purposes of the Republican State Convention:
* 1) to nominate candidates for statewide office and
* 2) to update the party platform every 4 years.

* While the main purpose and function of the 2024 convention is to nominate our Republican candidates for Attorney General and Lieutenant Governor, the party platform was last updated just 2 years ago and is not due for updates until 2026. Party rules can be found [HERE](http://links.email.in-gop.com/u/click?_t=9a0b7d408bc44ce9bb6828c91a267dbf&_m=c1aeaca879244a6f96b7f76c05a155a8&_e=aCMAkVsxXPIjPwomkZOGwXkKUmqlRxVZooG-PtWGuGPP2AMGMDkemamXIKjMrnpqdnhpM8no7L9o6QoM3CDQS-pmtAS930Ls_PKVKeHVPzu64OdfnVhRCQ2hw3QA4BvLg5Ws7rFwWjQMgV4RJ-cqQSwxO5n2NPVo6XzGSrnNO-FOGjSoneOI8Y-tIP1vt9BwDu_Cavu3a5cNsh6eHliNEsfcnt-nM1s9q4kHkMOAHmJgLI9WoZdArhMvUln4CzFkEoB18L8Emb4n6EfXsTeQ1naoFzKiRCqIE310KUX5rfkRtsbq_i9QIzPrmfytMaTL).

What does Indiana’s Attorney General do? Read below or [click here](http://links.email.in-gop.com/u/click?_t=9a0b7d408bc44ce9bb6828c91a267dbf&_m=c1aeaca879244a6f96b7f76c05a155a8&_e=aCMAkVsxXPIjPwomkZOGwdNhsxXr2ZvFfRNVz2LUDMvRWjaZnsL7O350vwDG4R7IfS1fpxE5fRohURCKwK2lkMjpn_P1DzGSth1hCl0Q_D7vGvnIRiyVZE8rP4OpuiaPK7oHC0WZQK7bP2ClGRThcjK-ZZuew_YXAR37kOwzcymHftmln78_8j0ilByZlpY6GGQHtJtK-VQ_sHmiAHwbwSrLrlGMgCDP88WcF6Zqyo5Z8rrhGAJyTKFFzmIDZMpY) to read more!
* The Office of the Indiana Attorney General represents the state in cases involving the state's interest, provides legal defense to state officials or agencies in court, and gives formal legal advisory opinions on constitutional or legal questions to state officials.
* The Office of the Attorney General is organized into eight divisions. These include: Advisory Division, Appeals Division, Complex Litigation, Consumer Protection Division, Litigation, Medicaid Fraud Control Division, Solicitor General, and Unclaimed Property Unit.

What does Indiana’s Lieutenant Governor do? Read below or [click here](http://links.email.in-gop.com/u/click?_t=9a0b7d408bc44ce9bb6828c91a267dbf&_m=c1aeaca879244a6f96b7f76c05a155a8&_e=aCMAkVsxXPIjPwomkZOGwQdr9iBrGGh8pXEO7C1AWq0ibpWpJAiOYrCMvARbJgJZzxmG9uLqU0WEDuwpzHlZzWRhXo46upie3a_6usqnJwyEt1PJfFEOdWscRAJ8oq0rq3xIrlEQeUsc3hLpm3vwIpx_R8fSLyBRzYRXQJdiBe--68fIULDwren9-S8n4UsHdUJPYuEE50TUA2z_cQfvAeR-BnmmP68zyjJJUycqHaE%3D) to read more!
* Constitutionally, the lieutenant governor serves as the president of the Indiana Senate. In addition, the lieutenant governor is charged with assuming the role of governor if the sitting governor becomes unable to fulfill the duties of office or if the office falls vacant due to death.
* Statutorily, the lieutenant governor oversees four state agencies including the Indiana State Department of Agriculture (ISDA), Indiana Housing and Community Development Authority (IHCDA), Office of Community and Rural Affairs (OCRA), and Indiana Destination Development Corporation (IDDC).

We hope this will set the groundwork for future State conventions. Click to learn more about the 2024 Convention. What is the Indiana Republican State Convention? Indiana code and Republican Party rules, specifically party rule 7-23, makes it clear that there are two purposes of the Republican State Convention: 1) to nominate candidates for statewide office and 2) to update the party platform every 4 years. While the main purpose and function of the 2024 convention is to nominate our Republican candidates for Attorney General and Lieutenant Governor, the party platform was last updated just 2 years ago and is not due for updates until 2026. Party rules can be found . What does Indiana’s Attorney General do? Read below or to read more! The Office of the Indiana Attorney General represents the state in cases involving the state's interest, provides legal defense to state officials or agencies in court, and gives formal legal advisory opinions on constitutional or legal questions to state officials. The Office of the Attorney General is organized into eight divisions. These include: Advisory Division, Appeals Division, Complex Litigation, Consumer Protection Division, Litigation, Medicaid Fraud Control Division, Solicitor General, and Unclaimed Property Unit. What does Indiana’s Lieutenant Governor do? Read below or to read more! Constitutionally, the lieutenant governor serves as the president of the Indiana Senate. In addition, the lieutenant governor is charged with assuming the role of governor if the sitting governor becomes unable to fulfill the duties of office or if the office falls vacant due to death. Every person should be able to show up in the world as they are. | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86914798/479431523/-1295403277?refcode=AU_JH_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240614_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODk4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YTE4NmRjYy04YTJhLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Lr8hXCb7TbxXyNAwwXeGrU43CCKlP2tBPVtKx7yqaQc=&emci=4740c9a9-772a-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=5a186dcc-8a2a-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=15529135) | Happy Pride, friend! It is a privilege to serve such a vibrant LGBTQIA+ community across the state. I have been fortunate to celebrate Pride Month by attending community events and speaking with local advocates, families, and friends. As a member of the Equality Caucus, I have worked with my colleagues to ensure that we are addressing the unique needs of the LGBTQIA+ community in legislation that is brought to the floor. **Fighting against the sustained and elevated attacks on LGBTQIA+ people starts with strong leadership** and my work on this issue has been endorsed by the Equality PAC and the Human Rights Campaign. I have fought to preserve the rights of LGBTQIA+ Americans and remedy injustices by voting in favor of legislation to protect the rights of LGBTQIA+ Americans, which includes:
* Voting for the **Equality Act** to ensure that the LGBTQIA+ community has equal access to protection in employment, housing, credit, jury duty, and federally funded programs under the law.
* Voting for the **Respect for Marriage Act** to enshrine the right to marriage for LGBTQIA+ couples into law.
* Co-sponsored the Pride in Mental Health Act, ERA Now Resolution, Mental Health Awareness Month, Pride Month Resolution, and the Family Violence Prevention and Services Improvement Act, all legislation that includes protection and support for the LGBTQ community.
* Voted **AGAINST** legislation that would enable schools to ban books that mention LGBTQIA+ characters and the National Defense Authorization Act which contained harmful amendments that targeted transgender and gender non-conforming service members and banned the Pride flag, among other issues. I also voted against legislation that would ban transgender athletes from participating in sports programs that align with their identity.

During my time in Congress, I have voiced support for protecting transgender youth from vicious attacks to ensure they are free from bullying and raised this concern to Xavier Bacerra, Secretary of Health and Human Services, during a hearing asking that he use his authority to protect LGBTQIA+ youth. I have also delivered floor speeches and observed moments of silence to acknowledge the achievements, pain, trauma, and history of the LGBTQIA+ community. One of the most impactful ways that we all can show up for the LGBTQIA+ community as a whole this Pride month is by electing leaders who will acknowledge the humanity of the LGBTQIA+ community and support legislation that reflects that. [**Will you contribute $5 or any amount to my campaign today to stand by my side in fighting for the rights of the LGBTQIA+ community? clean_body: Every person should be able to show up in the world as they are. | | Happy Pride, friend! It is a privilege to serve such a vibrant LGBTQIA+ community across the state. I have been fortunate to celebrate Pride Month by attending community events and speaking with local advocates, families, and friends. As a member of the Equality Caucus, I have worked with my colleagues to ensure that we are addressing the unique needs of the LGBTQIA+ community in legislation that is brought to the floor. Fighting against the sustained and elevated attacks on LGBTQIA+ people starts with strong leadership and my work on this issue has been endorsed by the Equality PAC and the Human Rights Campaign. I have fought to preserve the rights of LGBTQIA+ Americans and remedy injustices by voting in favor of legislation to protect the rights of LGBTQIA+ Americans, which includes: Voting for the Equality Act to ensure that the LGBTQIA+ community has equal access to protection in employment, housing, credit, jury duty, and federally funded programs under the law. Voting for the Respect for Marriage Act to enshrine the right to marriage for LGBTQIA+ couples into law. Co-sponsored the Pride in Mental Health Act, ERA Now Resolution, Mental Health Awareness Month, Pride Month Resolution, and the Family Violence Prevention and Services Improvement Act, all legislation that includes protection and support for the LGBTQ community. Voted AGAINST legislation that would enable schools to ban books that mention LGBTQIA+ characters and the National Defense Authorization Act which contained harmful amendments that targeted transgender and gender non-conforming service members and banned the Pride flag, among other issues. I also voted against legislation that would ban transgender athletes from participating in sports programs that align with their identity. During my time in Congress, I have voiced support for protecting transgender youth from vicious attacks to ensure they are free from bullying and raised this concern to Xavier Bacerra, Secretary of Health and Human Services, during a hearing asking that he use his authority to protect LGBTQIA+ youth. I have also delivered floor speeches and observed moments of silence to acknowledge the achievements, pain, trauma, and history of the LGBTQIA+ community. One of the most impactful ways that we all can show up for the LGBTQIA+ community as a whole this Pride month is by electing leaders who will acknowledge the humanity of the LGBTQIA+ community and support legislation that reflects that. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | = | = | = | = | = | = Let us join the LGBTQIA+ community not only this Pride month but all year in celebrating and defending our freedom to express our true selves without fear. — Jahana Hayes | | About Jahana** Jahana Hayes proudly represents Connecticut's 5th Congressional district. name: Debbie Mucarsel-Powell
subject: This is personal to me
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Debbie for Florida
body:
During Gun Violence Prevention Month, I want to make this clear:
| | |
---
I remember this pain like it was yesterday, friend.
At the age of 24, I was away from home working on my master's degree. One day, I received a call that changed my life — my family's life — forever: My dad, who had been living in Ecuador where I was born, was killed by a criminal with a gun.

My world was stopped by grief — the same sort of grief that has plagued countless Americans who have lost a loved one to gun violence. It's a pain that nobody should experience. And yet, decade after decade and mass shooting after mass shooting, Americans have endured the crisis of gun violence in our nation.
It's because gun violence is so deeply personal to me that I've worked so hard to prevent it. In Congress, I served as the vice chair of the Gun Violence Prevention Task Force. After leaving Congress, I joined Gabby Giffords' advocacy group as a senior advisor and continued to fight for safer communities and an end to the gun lobby's grip on Washington.
So, as we observe Gun Violence Prevention Month, I want to make something abundantly clear: **If you send me to the U.S. Senate, I will fight with everything I have to pass commonsense gun safety reform** — because nobody should have to live in fear that they could be killed by a gun at home, in school, or in their community.
I have the record and experience to back that promise up, friend. It's something I take pride in and that means a lot to me personally. My opponent, Rick Scott, on the other hand, has used his power to block gun safety reform at every step of his career. He's done nothing to make our communities safer, even as firearms are the number one cause of children's death in the United States.
**Look, if you believe our U.S. Senate should be made up of public servants who will champion gun safety reform, then I'm asking you to take action during Gun Violence Prevention Month:[Make a donation of $5 or more to help me defeat Rick Scott, win in Florida, and continue fighting for the gun safety reform our nation needs.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86915205/479432716/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1359-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDJlNGI5N2YtOGIyYS1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=3lonVyBVF5VLZkF13z6nwEdL-bElkohv1E2PUzFNdw0=)**
Everyone deserves to feel safe in their own community. Period. We have a long way to go in making that a reality, but I appreciate you doing your part today.

Debbie
|

Through Island Transit's zero-fare system, everyone has access to feel connected to our community. **This is just the beginning of what must be done for Island County and rural communities nationwide.** The work we are doing to improve Island Transit will be the blueprint for restructuring public transportation systems across the United States. From small communities in Northwest Washington, all the way to communities in Southern Florida, we need to invest to create and reinforce public transportation systems that can help communities thrive. I am fighting for even the smallest communities because they are essential to building stronger infrastructure systems throughout America. Connecting rural and urban communities through public transportation means no one is left behind, and we can use this momentum to move forward. We NEED to show Georgians his true record: calling for our Black brothers to be executed for crimes they never committed.**

GA Dems

body:
Your hard-earned dollars don’t just help this campaign, they show the GOP that you stand with my work as a congressman and a voice for PA-08.
| Peter,

I know I come to this team a lot, but I need you to know how much I appreciate your support. Your hard-earned dollars don’t just help this campaign, they show the GOP that you stand with my work as a congressman and a voice for PA-08.

But I know our work is far from over. There is still so much I want to get done for northeastern Pennsylvania, but I need your help to do it.

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Add your name to support my new Corporate Crimes Against Health Care Act
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Warren for Senate: https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/370?source=em-header&t=1001&akid=2216%2E4032634%2EkMspRh

Since last week, when I sent you the note below about
private equity, I’ve introduced a new bill focused on targeting the
corporate greed and private equity abuse in our health care system.

It’s called the Corporate Crimes Against Health Care Act.

And it’s badly needed because — I’ll just come right out and say it —
turning private equity loose in our health care system kills people. Lax
corporate accountability and transparency laws have allowed executives to
plunder hospitals, nursing homes, provider practices, and other health
care entities with impunity, and patients pay the price.

My bill would hold private equity executives accountable for ransacking
the health care sector. Here are three pieces of what it would do:

* Create a new criminal penalty of up to 6 years in prison for
executives who loot health care entities like nursing homes and
hospitals, if that looting results in a patient’s death.
* Provide state attorneys general and the Department of Justice with the
power to claw back all compensation, including salaries, issued to
private equity and portfolio company executives within a 10-year
period before or after an acquired health care firm experiences
serious, avoidable financial difficulties due to that looting.
* Authorize an associated civil penalty of up to 5 times the clawback
amount.

I’m rolling out this bill alongside my friend and colleague Senator Ed
Markey. I’d love to know if you’re also on board. We’ll need to work hard,
together, to overcome the private equity industry’s lobbyists and get this
passed.

[ https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-CCAHCAct/?source=EMZ20U_PET_E_20240614_V1S1&t=1006&akid=2216%2E4032634%2EkMspRh ]If you’re ready to become a grassroots co-sponsor of the Corporate
Crimes Against Health Care Act, please add your name here.

[ https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-CCAHCAct/?source=EMZ20U_PET_E_20240614_V1S1&t=1007&akid=2216%2E4032634%2EkMspRh ]ADD YOUR NAME

This issue hits home in Massachusetts, where private equity greed and
mismanagement recently drove Steward Health Care — which operates eight of
our Commonwealth’s hospitals — into bankruptcy.

My new bill would prevent what happened to Steward from ever happening
again, and it would finally hold private equity executives accountable for
wreaking havoc on our health care system.

This is a matter of life or death, and I’m fighting with everything I’ve
got to get this done. [ https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-CCAHCAct/?source=EMZ20U_PET_E_20240614_V1S1&t=1008&akid=2216%2E4032634%2EkMspRh ]Add your name if you’re with me, and let’s work to pass my Corporate Crimes
Against Health Care Act.

Thanks for being a part of this,

Elizabeth

--- Forwarded message ---
From: Elizabeth Warren
Date: Saturday, June 7
Subject: The truth about Red Lobster

Don’t blame it on the endless shrimp.

Recently, Red Lobster declared bankruptcy, and even though it’s no
laughing matter, the jokes practically wrote themselves — how could a
company that offers endless shrimp NOT run out of money?

But if you look right beneath the surface, you’ll see Red Lobster’s real
downfall wasn’t endless shrimp — it was private equity’s endless greed.

You see, a private equity firm bought Red Lobster in 2014, and did their
thing: Looted profits, loaded Red Lobster up with debt, and saddled the
restaurant chain with extra real-estate costs — following a model that
reaps rewards for private equity owners but leaves communities, workers,
and customers holding the bag.

Now, even though Red
Lobster is a recent example of this blood-sucking phenomenon, private
equity’s harmful effects go far, far beyond the restaurant industry — from
retail stores to nursing homes to fisheries to manufactured housing
communities to hospital systems (including Steward Health Care in
Massachusetts).

Private equity should not be allowed to loot one business after another,
and I have introduced the most comprehensive bill to overhaul the private
equity industry.

My Stop Wall Street Looting Act would put private investment fund managers
on the hook for the companies they control, end looting, empower workers
and investors, and safeguard the markets from risky corporate debt.

But it’ll be an uphill battle to overcome the powerful interests who want
to preserve a status quo that means big profits for them — even as stores
get closed, consumers get cheated, workers get laid off, and pensions get
raided.

[ https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-contraceptionact/?source=EMZ20U_PET_E_20240614_V1S1&t=1009&akid=2216%2E4032634%2EkMspRh ]Say you’re in this fight to stop private equity from ransacking our
economy, and sign on as a grassroots co-sponsor of my Stop Wall Street
Looting Act.

[ https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-contraceptionact/?source=EMZ20U_PET_E_20240614_V1S1&t=1010&akid=2216%2E4032634%2EkMspRh ]ADD YOUR NAME

Here are a few big pieces of what my Stop Wall Street Looting Act would
accomplish:

* Fundamentally reform the industry by closing the legal, tax, and
regulatory loopholes that allow private equity firms to capture all
the rewards of their investments while insulating themselves from
risk.
* Require private investment firms, the firm’s general partners, and
their insiders to share responsibility for the liabilities of
companies under their control — including debt, legal judgments and
pension-related obligations — to better align the incentives of
private equity firms and the companies they own.
* Ban dividends to investors and the outsourcing of jobs for two years
after a firm is acquired — ending the extraction of resources from
acquired companies.
* Prevent private equity firms from walking away when a company fails
and protect workers by improving rules so workers are more likely to
receive severance and pensions in a bankruptcy.
* Require private equity managers to disclose fees, returns, and other
information about their funds so that investors can monitor their
investments and shop around.
* Reinstate Dodd-Frank provisions that require regulators to address
risky leverage.

Big private equity firms have fat profits on the line here, so they’ll do
everything they can to block our reforms. That means we can win only if we
link arms, raise our voices together, and fight from the heart.

[ https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-contraceptionact/?source=EMZ20U_PET_E_20240614_V1S1&t=1011&akid=2216%2E4032634%2EkMspRh ]Add
your name here to say you support my Stop Wall Street Looting Act, and
side by side, we’ll tackle the private equity industry’s abuses.

Thanks for being a part of this,

Elizabeth

body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

For years, Democrats and Republicans have used immigration as a political football, passing the blame back and forth. At a time when we need real solutions, the President’s latest executive action is just politics as usual.

Please read my latest op-ed with State Senator Edgar Flores, published by MSNBC. We break down a set of common sense ideas that a majority of people can agree on to improve our immigration system.

READ: Biden’s latest border policy is no long-term solution [https://www.msnbc.com/opinion/msnbc-opinion/biden-border-action-khanna-flores-rcna157014]

https://www.msnbc.com/opinion/msnbc-opinion/biden-border-action-khanna-flores-rcna157014 [https://www.msnbc.com/opinion/msnbc-opinion/biden-border-action-khanna-flores-rcna157014]

We write: “The status quo in our immigration system does no good for immigrants. The years of focus on scoring political points have not yielded any solutions — nor have they addressed voters’ concerns. If we can move past divisive rhetoric, Congress and the president can get something big done on immigration — something worthy of American ideals.”

Securing our border while also showing compassion for those who have risked their lives to find safety of their own must be key values for our party.

Please take five minutes to read our op-ed [https://www.msnbc.com/opinion/msnbc-opinion/biden-border-action-khanna-flores-rcna157014] and text me at (650) 999-9610 to let me know your thoughts.

Thank you for your activism and all that you do.

In solidarity,
Ro
