_“Never give in. Never, never, never — in nothing great or small, large or petty — never give in, except to convictions of honor and good sense. Never yield to force. Never yield to the apparently overwhelming might of the enemy.”_

Those are the words of Prime Minister Winston Churchill in October 1941.
But they are also the clear guiding principles of one of the most impressive U.S. Senate candidates running for office today. And I am proud to give him my strongest endorsement.

His name is Hung Cao. He and his parents fled Vietnam just before the fall of Saigon. They escaped the tyranny and oppressive control of a government that brazenly arrested anyone with whom they disagreed.

America saved Hung’s life - and he repaid this country with 25 years of service after attending the U.S. Naval Academy.

He fought for our freedom in war zones across the world, from Afghanistan to Iraq and Somalia.

But now, Hung is in a new fight: defeating the radical socialism that’s destroying our country from the inside out.

This fight is personal for him, Fellow Patriot. He escaped tyranny and communism once before. _Now, he’s not going to let America go down the same dark path._

Hung is dedicated to putting America first, to fighting for our liberties, to exposing the tactics of tyranny that threaten our very future. He is one of the rare few who will stand up to any foe. He won’t bend and he won’t break. But he needs warriors like you by his side to fight and win.

I’m proud to support this incredible patriot in the fight of his life, and I hope you’ll stand with me to send Hung Cao to the U.S. Senate.**

name: Eugene Vindman
subject: I never thought this would happen…
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jason Crow for Congress
body:
|
#
---
Our democracy teeters on the brink. Eugene Vindman is running for Virginia’s open 7th Congressional District. Eugene served 25 years in the Army and is ready to fight with Jason Crow to defend our democracy against Donald Trump’s allies. We hope you’ll read his message below, and then split a donation between his and Jason’s campaigns. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86918917/479445717/1707145561?refcode=AU_JC_FR_TAN_MMG_AC30_20240614_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODUyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYTQ4M2U0YS05NTJhLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lLdViFHl5xXKc6IUzhmEjn9bd4FaGCBVzhyUwCa2K_c=) I never imagined that I would be here today, friend. My name is Eugene Vindman. I’m a Jewish-Ukrainian immigrant whose family came to America to find hope like so many others, and I was proud to join the military and serve my country. When my brother, Lt. Col. Alexander Vindman, and I witnessed President Trump abuse his power and threaten to block Ukraine’s military aid unless they investigated Joe Biden, we refused to stay silent. We reported the call up the chain of command and it eventually led to his impeachment, but it cost us our careers when we were fired in retaliation. Back then, **I never envisioned I would run for Congress,** but in the nearly five years since that phone call, the Republicans have shown the dangerous path they are willing to tread. From the insurrection of January 6th to their assaults on fair elections and fundamental rights, Republicans have gone all-in on authoritarianism. Now, our democracy teeters on the brink. name: Hill Harper
subject: My Opponent's Failures vs. Our Future
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY HILL HARPER FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1270%2E62735%2EJPwxJQ)
Peter,
I’m Hill Harper, running for the U.S. Senate to represent Michigan. Even though my opponent and I both have a D next to our name on the ballot there are stark differences between us. Our state deserves a leader who fights for justice, fairness, and a brighter future for all.
**My opponent has turned a blind eye to crucial legislation like the George Floyd Justice in Policing Act and the Cannabis and Expungement Act.**
**I've dedicated much of my life to reducing mass incarceration.** It's heartbreaking that in our state, you can run a profitable business selling a product today for which you might have been imprisoned for just a few years ago, with no pathway to expunge that record. This isn’t justice. This is why federal expungement is crucial—it’s about fairness and giving people a real chance to rebuild their lives.
When it comes to education, **my opponent voted against student loan debt relief.** Our young people deserve opportunities, not mountains of debt. **I believe in investing in their futures.**
Healthcare is a fundamental right, yet **my opponent didn’t co-sponsor Medicare for All.** As a cancer survivor and the son of a psychiatrist, I know firsthand the importance of universal and mental healthcare. It’s unacceptable that one-third of GoFundMe campaigns are for medical expenses. **We need a system that truly cares for our people.**
**I’m not a career politician. I’m a 32-year union member, a small business owner in Detroit, and a Harvard Law graduate. But more importantly, I care deeply about our community. Titles and degrees don't matter—what matters is the heart we have for the people we serve.**
This is a pivotal moment for Michigan's future. Open Senate seats are rare, often only coming available when a Senator retires or passes away. This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to elect a leader who will shape the future we all deserve.

If we want more than lip service to a hypothetical ceasefire, we can’t let up now. **With just 10 days left until the deadline to get on the Illinois ballot, we need everyone to go all in** to make sure every single voter has a choice on the ballot to stop endless war and genocide. We have a powerhouse team of community organizers working to get the tens of thousands of signatures we need in Illinois - but we have to raise $60,000 by the end of this week to pay them for their work so they can keep going. **With 1 million lives hanging by a thread, we**** _must_****rise to meet this moment. Please contribute whatever you can turn up the heat on Genocide Joe in**** _every_****state and force him to stop the killing.**

body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=38912%2E3422442%2E-w6lca)
Derek,
As a consumer protection attorney, there’s a lot I’ve always disliked about political emails. Emails that try to shame or terrify you into donating aren’t my style.
You’ve probably seen emails that say things like:
“We need 5,238 donors from YOUR zip code.” This is fake. We have goals and deadlines, and donations from different parts of the state or country can signal support, but there’s no crazy math like this happening.
“Donate $5 today and it will be triple matched.” I promise nobody is really doing this.
“Warning: Payment incomplete.” I despise these misleading emails that make you think you’ve missed a bill. Invoking this type of fear in people is unacceptable.
I’ve introduced legislation to crack down on scam PACs, which can often be the worst offenders. Scam PACs are political organizations that exist to steal money rather than to support a cause or candidate. Their expenditures go solely to “consultants” rather than real causes, and it’s a shameful way to make a quick buck.
Here’s what is real: our fundraising deadlines and the facts we give you about the candidates I am supporting. There is urgency, yes, because we’re less than six months away from November and we need to take back the House.
Our end of quarter deadlines are some of the most important, as we have to publicly report how much we raise every three months. But our monthly and even weekly internal goals help us hit those quarterly goals, and as Election Day nears, each week’s fundraising really helps our work.
**[Truly, whatever zip code you’re in, I’d be so appreciative of your support! Can you make a contribution today ahead of the mid-point in the month?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240614?refcode=em20240614-38912&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38912_3422442_-w6lca&akid=38912%2E3422442%2E-w6lca)**
[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240614?refcode=em20240614-38912&refcode2=38912_3422442_-w6lca&akid=38912%2E3422442%2E-w6lca)
Thanks for reading, and thanks for supporting Truth to Power today.
Katie

**Katie Porter started Truth to Power to support Democrats who reject corporate PAC money** and are running to protect the environment, restore the nationwide right to an abortion, and create an economy that works for working people. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/truth-to-power-1?refcode=em20240614-38912&amounts=&t=2&refcode2=38912_3422442_-w6lca&akid=38912%2E3422442%2E-w6lca)**

name: Emma Brown, Giffords.org
subject: Making sure you saw today’s SCOTUS news
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
Join us in calling on Congress to reinstate a ban on bump stocks
#

Hi team, it’s GIFFORDS Executive Director Emma Brown. I wanted to make sure you saw the note my team sent earlier regarding today’s Supreme Court decision striking down ATF’s ban on bump stocks. Essentially legalizing machine guns.
This decision poses a grave risk to public safety, and we are going to fight with all that we’ve got to get Congress to act on this critical issue.
[**Will you help us out by adding your name to our petition to call on Congress to reinstate a ban on bump stocks?**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_bumpstocks_pet_june24/?source=em240614-2-15&refcode2=8314.3935704.tfCE2k&akid=8314%2E3935704%2EtfCE2k)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_bumpstocks_pet_june24/?source=em240614-2-15&refcode2=8314.3935704.tfCE2k&akid=8314%2E3935704%2EtfCE2k)**
Thanks so much for taking a stand,
Emma
* * *
[](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_bumpstocks_pet_june24/?source=em240614-2-15&refcode2=8314.3935704.tfCE2k&akid=8314%2E3935704%2EtfCE2k)

We’re outraged.
**This morning, the Supreme Court struck down ATF’s bump stock ban.**
This rule was enacted in 2017 after a mass shooter—who was armed with AR-15s accessorized with bump stocks—opened fire at the Route 91 Harvest music festival in Las Vegas. Within minutes, over 1,000 rounds were fired, killing 60 people and injuring over 400 others.
**Bump stocks turn semi-automatic weapons into fully automatic machine guns. They should be illegal.** Yet the Supreme Court’s decision stated that a firearm equipped with a bump stock does not meet the definition of a machine gun under federal law. The court’s decision is reckless and dangerous.
**Justice Sonia Sotomayor said it best in her dissent: "When I see a bird that walks like a duck, swims like a duck, and quacks like a duck, I call that bird a duck."**
Congress must take immediate action to reinstate a ban on bump stocks. Lives are at risk.
[**Will you sign our petition right now to demand that Congress takes action to reinstate a federal ban on bump stocks?**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_bumpstocks_pet_june24/?source=em240614-2-15&refcode2=8314.3935704.tfCE2k&akid=8314%2E3935704%2EtfCE2k)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_bumpstocks_pet_june24/?source=em240614-2-15&refcode2=8314.3935704.tfCE2k&akid=8314%2E3935704%2EtfCE2k)**
Machine guns do not belong on our streets. This shouldn’t be a controversial statement.
Shame on the Supreme Court for making it one.
\- Team GIFFORDS

Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. www.Giffords.org
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com . We try to send only the most important information and opportunities to participate via email, but click [here](https://go.giffords.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1&akid=8314%2E3935704%2EtfCE2k) if you'd like to unsubscribe. Giffords PAC was started to support elected officials who step up to fight the gun violence epidemic. Thank you for standing with Gabby and the Giffords team.

| Thank you for your interest in Hogan For Maryland!
Following Governor Hogan’s [**landslide primary election win**](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=a096d6f31b&e=3ef74f1f93) , Hogan for Maryland has been taking the Old Line State by storm on our [**Strong Independent Leadership Tour**](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=49dcd4734a&e=3ef74f1f93)**—it's been a busy month!**
**What We’ve Been Up To:** So far on the Strong Independent Leadership Tour, Hogan for Maryland has made **over 25 stops across the state** , **rolled out 8 more coalitions** , **received 6 union endorsements** , and **announced 5 policy plans and priorities** —and we are just getting started!
**Mark Your Calendar:** In the next few weeks, Governor Hogan w! If you are interested in attending, let us know by signing up [here](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=9548049788&e=3ef74f1f93).
* **June 22:** Annapolis Juneteenth Festival at 11:00 AM
* **June 23:** Asians For Hogan Event at China Garden Han Gong at 5:00 PM
* **June 30:** Hereford Parade at 11:00 AM
* **July 4:** Dundalk Independence Day Parade in the morning, and the Annapolis 4th of July Parade in the afternoon! 🇺🇸

**Get Involved:** As we roll full steam ahead into the general election, here are more ways to stay involved:
* **Join a coalition.** Our campaign coalition program is fully off the ground, with new coalitions including [“Women for Hogan”](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=76408b0394&e=3ef74f1f93) to [“Small Business Owners for Hogan”](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=d86fe8192a&e=3ef74f1f93) to [“Democrats for Hogan”](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=1a73ea28f1&e=3ef74f1f93) and much, much more! Find the right groups for you and for information on how to join a coalition, visit: [larryhogan.com/coalitions](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=ad2f3d8bc3&e=3ef74f1f93).

* **Bring a friend.** We are always looking to add more seats to the table here at Hogan for Maryland. Help a friend get involved through our [volunteer portal](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=40bd991f22&e=3ef74f1f93) or by joining a coalition too!

* **Share Governor Hogan’s message:** Follow Governor Hogan on [Facebook](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=62c79cbfc6&e=3ef74f1f93), [Twitter](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=21444eed24&e=3ef74f1f93), and [Instagram](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=d877f3ca25&e=3ef74f1f93) and see below for some of the content Governor Hogan has put out on the airwaves lately, and don’t forget to amplify!

---
[](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=9b734e5431&e=3ef74f1f93)
| **Strong Independent Leadership Tour.** Hogan for Maryland recently announced our [Strong Independent Leadership Tour](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=6b75d9f929&e=3ef74f1f93). Over the past few weeks, Governor Hogan has been traveling the state putting forward bipartisan common sense solutions on the pressing challenges facing Marylanders, including crime, education, and affordability.
---
| **Where we have Been:** Since announcing the [Strong Independent Leadership Tour](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=f5ade20b9d&e=3ef74f1f93), **Governor Hogan has already made over 25 stops** across the state and met hundreds of Marylanders. Some of these stops include:

* **Supporting Our State’s First Responders:** Governor Hogan has met with members of the [Fraternal Order of Prince George's County Police Lodge 89](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=aed59c5136&e=3ef74f1f93), members of the [Anne Arundel County FOP 70](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=d7c8f281d2&e=3ef74f1f93) in Crownsville, the [Baltimore Fire Officers Association IAFF Local 964](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=c42563bef3&e=3ef74f1f93) in Baltimore, and the [Salisbury Fire Department](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=1d7200ed53&e=3ef74f1f93) on the Eastern Shore.

* In Ocean City, Governor Hogan met with the Ocean City Career Firefighter Paramedics Association IAFF Local 4269 and the Worcester County Professional Firefighters IAFF Local 4916 on the Ocean City Boardwalk—where he received their [formal endorsement](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=147bfa5fbe&e=3ef74f1f93)!

* **Happy Pride Month!:** On the first day of Pride Month, Governor Hogan [participated](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=ae7565d285&e=3ef74f1f93) in the [Annapolis Pride Parade](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=7f7c57233d&e=3ef74f1f93), celebrating and supporting our state’s LGBTQ+ community.

* **Greeks for Hogan:** This month, Governor Hogan attended both the [Annapolis Greek Festival](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=c22e966158&e=3ef74f1f93) at Ss. Constantine & Helen Greek Orthodox Church and the annual [St. Nicholas Greek Folk Festival](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=a21f594a94&e=3ef74f1f93) in Baltimore City!

* **Kingdom Fellowship AME Church:** Last Sunday, Governor Hogan joined Reverend Matthew Watley and members of [Kingdom Fellowship AME Church](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=cbc2ee1c0a&e=3ef74f1f93) in Prince George’s County for a church service.

**Five Policy Plans and Priorities:** Hogan for Maryland has been on a roll announcing Governor Hogan’s policy plans and priorities he will pursue as a US Senator.

* [**10-Point Crime Plan**](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=c3f386c7dd&e=3ef74f1f93)**:** In late May, Governor Hogan [unveiled](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=ee87ed7872&e=3ef74f1f93) a 10-point plan to address violent crime–including steps to deal with violent offenders, back law enforcement, and support victims. Governor Hogan will get guns and violent criminals off the street.

* [**Education:**](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=d6ec8beda3&e=3ef74f1f93) Following a visit to [Archbishop Borders School](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=7d5ca98244&e=3ef74f1f93) in Highlandtown, Hogan for Maryland released education priorities focused on reform, innovation, and empowering parents.

* [**Relief for Retirees**](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=c92e120dce&e=3ef74f1f93)**:** Governor Hogan visited [North Oaks Senior Living Community](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=1867dd90ef&e=3ef74f1f93) in Pikesville, where he discussed the policy priorities he will fight for in Washington to continue delivering results for Maryland retirees.

* [**Expanding Employment Opportunities**](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=6620f021b0&e=3ef74f1f93)**:** Following a visit to the [Jane Addams Resource Corporation](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=161fd1672b&e=3ef74f1f93) in Baltimore City, Governor Hogan released a new plan to remove barriers and expand opportunities for workers–building on his first-in-the-nation initiative to eliminate college degree requirements for jobs in state government.

* [**Small Business Relief**](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=53cfd69610&e=3ef74f1f93)**:** Following a visit to [Marlin Steel](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=ba7dc0dd01&e=3ef74f1f93) in Baltimore, Governor Hogan released his Small Business Relief Plan plan that focuses on reducing the tax burden for small businesses, cutting excessive and burdensome red tape, and making it easier to support employees.

**Six Union Endorsements:** Hogan for Maryland has been proud to receive six endorsements from unions across a variety of industries.
---
[](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=393e65ccef&e=3ef74f1f93)
| Click on each of the endorsements to learn more:
* [International Longshoremen’s Association Local 333](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=255d12e5c9&e=3ef74f1f93)
* [State Law Enforcement Officers Labor Alliance](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=e902d09e05&e=3ef74f1f93)
* [International Union of Police Associations ](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=7b2f6921b5&e=3ef74f1f93)
* [Ocean City Career Firefighter Paramedics Association IAFF Local 4269 ](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=3418b4fdc8&e=3ef74f1f93)
* [Worcester County Professional Firefighters IAFF Local 4916](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=3c1c64baf1&e=3ef74f1f93)
* [Marine Engineers' Beneficial Association](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=e4d10baa3b&e=3ef74f1f93)

---
[](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=62299047c4&e=3ef74f1f93)
| **Governor Hogan on Maryland’s Fiscal Future.** Governor Hogan [has been vocal](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=9ebb34a657&e=3ef74f1f93) about the recent downgrade of Maryland’s financial outlook, saying:
---
| During stops in Baltimore County at [The Essen Room](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=f92e72f8fc&e=3ef74f1f93), Governor Hogan caught up with Fox45 and expressed his concerns about the state’s financial outlook:
---
[](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=c2b4890ccc&e=3ef74f1f93)
| [Watch Governor Hogan’s comments on Fox45. ](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=9ab5c0af5b&e=3ef74f1f93)
**Small Business Relief.** This week, Governor Hogan spoke to WBAL following his tour of [Marlin Steel](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=031a259f5c&e=3ef74f1f93) in Baltimore.
---
[](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=9ffdd45da3&e=3ef74f1f93)
| [Watch Governor Hogan on WBAL.](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=0236785315&e=3ef74f1f93)
**Expanding Pathways to the American Dream:** Governor Hogan penned an editorial piece titled [**“To open opportunities for workers, the federal government must lead by example”**](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=2fa4fec09f&e=3ef74f1f93)**** in the Washington Examiner discussing the need to remove barriers and expand opportunities for workers across the country—building from the proven success of his [first-in-the-nation initiative](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=094fdd4e22&e=3ef74f1f93) to eliminate college degree requirements for jobs in state government.

We are beyond grateful for your enthusiastic support for our campaign, and look forward to seeing you out on the trail soon!
To stay up to date on all of Governor Hogan’s travels and announcements, follow his social media pages on [Facebook](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=6bb1e9276b&e=3ef74f1f93), [Twitter](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=2b02991753&e=3ef74f1f93), and [Instagram](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=7b5c7e4ef5&e=3ef74f1f93) — and don’t forget to amplify!
Talk to you soon!
Rob**Team Hogan**

Peter,

[**SIGN THE CARD >>**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=af9f3934d4f943c08f8b3c7ea2929fb8&_e=dTp72kRpQiOd-kwOPmq-HGLPQZtVkgHHP46IDne4CKgHl1prnp8wfriH3P3uZ2msh2VONR7j5Y0sLpqkyf_owwn6cn7KKlzNrvs1BjQkNF1e1kkOGRoseKGtXv4LotuiJ2Z8zd6GayFxBzi6rIxteoHSUzBN6VnT_z5buLIfecfuLyh6lphWe49zHgvchqmmnct1WMEOfombie_ENL7l2vi0z8WJZrBhoTxGyiyNRqCwS2U8cQYBmDgG7KU_6QP9OJ_WNns76eeDzCtNwms_KJFV5N7mXCJwQt2u999hGML9FndpnQb0Iw_ntf6qenn7YG_4WHLdetwJzITDopeXp_x3b8O8D1lxAAY5Ry7dyHwcdKfErwUfO8UhQeTlpYuHIPu9sotvjWQf2rgF2Zld_RZf-eKboj6W4yJc9W71Uvbf7b6Z2_5-loz_emyQV-LEBB-Nt6FsqWQm2jOaowD61jzibBjsde2nIzm56uAya--Sj3hOqBlQqhpeAObl3wdR)

Hey there, it’s Jon Tester.

The general election has officially begun in Montana, and one thing is already clear: **My opponent and I couldn’t be more different.**
* Tim Sheehy grew up in a multi-million dollar lake house in the big city suburbs. I’m a third-generation dirt farmer, born and raised in Montana.
* Tim Sheehy supports a national abortion ban. I'm fighting to protect personal freedoms.
* Tim Sheehy will be a mouthpiece for Mitch McConnell’s agenda. I always take my cues from Montanans.

[**This race will be decided by a mere handful of votes, so every action we take could be the difference between victory and defeat. Can I count on you to split a donation between my campaign and Fight for Reform to help power us to victory?**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/44769?t=7&akid=21550%2E4449941%2EgozSsz) Whether he’s playing cowboy or pretending he grew up surrounded by farmland, Tim Sheehy is shamelessly lying when it’s clear he doesn’t understand a lick about what makes rural America so special.

**Montana deserves a senator that appreciates everything that makes our state the Last Best Place—that’s why we have to win this race.**

This seat is on track to become the most expensive and competitive Senate race in the country. Outside groups are spending nearly $65 million on attacks trying to turn me into someone I’m not—because they can’t beat who I am. **I need your help to fight back, so I’m asking:**

[**Will you split a donation between my campaign to send this seven-fingered dirt farmer back to the United States Senate so I can keep fighting for Montana and help Fight For Reform elect state and local Democrats?**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/44769?t=8&akid=21550%2E4449941%2EgozSsz) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Fight for Reform and Jon Tester will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/44770?t=9&akid=21550%2E4449941%2EgozSsz)

With your help, we can overcome the attacks and win this critical race.

Thank you,

Jon

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1536%2E135344%2EVuK5w-)

Friend -
Donald Trump is heading to Detroit this weekend, and he won’t be alone. Here’s a list of people that will be with him:
* Congressman Matt Gaetz
* Senator Rick Scott
* Congresswoman Marjorie Taylor Greene
* Right-wing internet personality Candace Owens
* RNC Chairwoman Lara Trump
* Donald Trump Jr.
* MyPillow CEO and conspiracy theorist Mike Lindell
* Founder of the alt-right publication _Breitbart_ and former Trump strategist Steve Bannon
* Republican operative Roger Stone

Why are these folks rolling into Detroit? They’re all speakers at a conference hosted by an organization called Turning Point Action, which promotes extreme conservative causes and candidates with a focus on young people. According to recent reports, they’re also coordinating heavily with the Trump campaign and running significant door-knocking operations in a handful of battleground states, including Michigan.
The conference, which will be held at Detroit’s Huntington Place, is likely to focus on conspiracy theories and hateful rhetoric, as they have at other events.
And that’s not all: Trump will also be coming to speak at a roundtable with Black faith groups in Detroit – a clear sign that he continues to court Black voters in an effort to win them over in this election. So on the very same day, he will try to make inroads with Black voters as a way to win our state, and then go court the furthest right of his base.
Bottom line: He knows that there is no winning the presidency without winning Michigan and he is attempting to cobble together a coalition of bedfellows that will help him get there. And he will be back again and again to spread his lies and fire up voters.
[**We can’t stop Republicans from putting up far-right candidates and endorsing destructive ideas, but we can beat them, over and over again, and show them that they cannot win with extreme candidates. That’s what Elissa intends to do, but she only can with your support:**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-june24.nyVfY7&refcode=em240614-2&t=2&akid=1536%2E135344%2EVuK5w-)
